machine.definition:
n. any mechanical or electrical device that transmits or modifies energy to perform or assist in the performance of human tasks
n. an efficient person
n. an intricate organization that accomplishes its goals efficiently
n. a device for overcoming resistance at one point by applying force at some other point
machine.translation: n. 机器, 机械装置, 机构, 自动售货机, 机械般工作的人\nvt. 以机器制造

examples.en: If you had a time machine, where would you go?
examples.zh: 要是你有架时光机，你想去哪儿？

examples.en: Did you take the clothes out of the washing machine?
examples.zh: 你把衣服从洗衣机里拿出来了吗？

examples.en: This machine was of great use to us all.
examples.zh: 这个机器对我们都很有用。

machinery.definition: n. machines or machine systems collectively\nn. a system of means and activities whereby a social institution functions
machinery.translation: n. 机器, 机械装置, 机构\n[化] 机械

examples.en: An old worker was found repairing machinery in the workshop.
examples.zh: 有人发现一个老工人在车间修机器。

examples.en: Something must be wrong with the machinery.
examples.zh: 这个机器一定有什么地方不对劲。

examples.en: Then arose the question of where we were to get the necessary machinery.
examples.zh: 于是出现了一个问题，哪里能找我们需要的机器。

macro.definition: n. a single computer instruction that results in a series of instructions in machine language\ns. very large in scale or scope or capability
macro.translation: pref. 宏\na. 巨大的, 大量的\n[计] 宏

examples.en: He took a lot of macro photographs of disgusting Canadian bugs.
Use macros to plan your daily nutritional needs.
jEdit macros are written in BeanShell.

mad.definition:
s roused to anger
s affected with madness or insanity
s marked by uncontrolled excitement or emotion
s very foolish
mad.translation: a. 疯狂的, 发疯的, 生气的, 愚蠢的, 狂欢的\nn. 狂怒

examples.en: For a moment there, I thought he had gone mad.
examples.zh: 一时间我还以为他疯了。

examples.en: I know you're probably mad about what I said yesterday.
examples.zh: 我知道我昨天说的那番话把你弄得很生气。

examples.en: The prisoners fought one another like so many mad people.
examples.zh: 囚犯们像疯子一样互相殴斗。

magazine.definition:
n. a periodic publication containing pictures and stories and articles of interest to those who purchase it or subscribe to it
n. product consisting of a paperback periodic publication as a physical object
n. a business firm that publishes magazines
n. a light-tight supply chamber holding the film and supplying it for exposure as required
magazine.translation: n. 杂志, 仓库, 弹盒, 胶卷盒\n[计] 卡片箱, 介质装卸程序

examples.en: I usually bring a magazine with me when I travel.
examples.zh: 我去旅游的时候通常都会拿上一本杂志。

examples.en: This kind of magazine can do harm to young people.
examples.zh: 这种杂志对年轻人有害。

examples.en: Don't throw out this magazine. I haven't read it yet.
examples.zh: 这本杂志不要扔。我还没看呢。

magic.definition: n. any art that invokes supernatural powers
magic.translation: n. 魔术, 魔法\na. 魔术的, 有魔力的, 不可思议的

examples.en: Magic plays an important part in primitive society.
examples.zh: 巫术在原始社会扮演重要角色。

examples.en: My parents say that YouTube and streaming services cheapen the magic of film.
examples.zh: 我父母说，YouTube 和串流平台让电影的魔力大打折扣。

examples.en: Sami tried some easy magic tricks.
examples.zh: 萨米变过几个简单的魔术。

magistrate.definition: n. a lay judge or civil authority who administers the law (especially one who conducts a court dealing with minor offenses)
magistrate.translation: n. 长官, 法官, 推事\n[法] 司法行政官, 治安法官, 地方法官

examples.en: The defender finished, the magistrate said he had nothing to declare.
Obscenity is whatever happens to shock some elderly and ignorant magistrate.
A magistrate was assassinated by the mafia.

magnet.definition: n. (physics) a device that attracts iron and produces a magnetic field
magnet.translation: n. 磁铁, 有吸引力之人, 有吸引力之物\n[化] 磁体

examples.en: The earth is like a big magnet.
examples.zh: 地球像一块大吸铁石一样。

examples.en: Keeton put magnets on the heads of his pigeons.
examples.zh: 基顿把磁铁放在他的鸽子的头上。

examples.en: Earth is like a big magnet.
examples.zh: 地球像一块大吸铁石一样。

magnetic.definition:
a. of or relating to or caused by magnetism
a. having the properties of a magnet; i.e. of attracting iron or steel
a. capable of being magnetized
a. determined by earth's magnetic fields
magnetic.translation: a. 有磁性的, 有吸引力的, 催眠术的\n[医] 磁[性]的

examples.en: Magnetic fields are invisible.
examples.zh: 磁场是看不见的。

magnificent.translation: a. 华丽的, 高尚的, 宏伟的

examples.en: A sacred ritual took place in the magnificent temple.
examples.zh: 一个神圣的仪式在庄严的庙宇中举行。

examples.en: Life is a magnificent gown full of lice.
examples.zh: 生命是一袭华美的袍子，爬满了虱子。

examples.en: A magnificent idea materialized in front of him.
examples.zh: 一个绝妙的想法浮现在他的脑海。

magnify.definition: v. increase in size, volume or significance
magnify.translation: vt. 放大, 扩大, 赞美, 夸大\nvi. 有放大能力

examples.en: This microscope magnifies objects by 100 times.
examples.zh: 这台显微镜能把物体放大一百倍。

magnitude.definition: n. the property of relative size or extent (whether large or small)\nn. relative importance
magnitude.translation: n. 巨大, 重大, 重要, 大小, 数量, 星等(指星的亮度)\n[计] 大小; 值

examples.en: A massive earthquake of magnitude 8.8 hit the Japanese islands today.
examples.zh: 今天，8.8级的强大地震袭击了日本的岛屿。

maiden.definition: n an unmarried girl (especially a virgin)\nn (cricket) an over in which no runs are scored\ns serving to set in motion
maiden.translation: n. 年轻未婚女子, 少女, 处女\na. 未婚的, 处女的, 初次的, 无经验的

examples.en: I'm planning to take my mother's maiden name.
examples.zh: 我打算随母姓。

examples.en: The Titanic's maiden voyage didn't go so well.
examples.zh: 泰塔尼克号的首航不是很好的。

mail.definition:
n. the bags of letters and packages that are transported by the postal service
n. the system whereby messages are transmitted via the post office
n. a conveyance that transports the letters and packages that are conveyed by the postal system
n. any particular collection of letters or packages that is delivered
mail.translation: n. 邮件, 邮政, 邮递, 盔甲\nvt. 邮寄, 给...穿盔甲\n[计] 邮件

examples.en: How about we use "express mail" so it arrives tomorrow.
examples.zh: 要不寄“特快邮件”明天就可以到。

examples.en: The mail train lost most of its mail in the fire.
examples.zh: 那场火灾把邮车上的邮件烧掉了一大半。

examples.en: Strange, why can't I send any mail to your mail box?
examples.zh: 你的邮箱为什么发不过去邮件呢，奇怪。

main.definition: n. any very large body of (salt) water\nn. a principal pipe in a system that distributes water or gas or electricity or that collects sewage\ns. of force; of the greatest possible intensity
main.translation: n. 主要部分, 干线, 体力, 力量, 主群组\na. 主要的, 重要的, 全力的\n[计] 主群组

examples.en: Tom's main problem is he has no sense of humour.
examples.zh: 汤姆的主要问题是他一点幽默感都没有

examples.en: That wasn't the main reason Tom needed to do that.
examples.zh: 这不是汤姆要做那件事的主要原因。

examples.en: One of the main products of this country is coffee.
examples.zh: 这个国家的主要产品之一是咖啡。

examples.en: The bat's diet consists mainly of insects and fruit.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠的食物主要包括昆虫和水果。

examples.en: That company deals mainly in imported goods.
examples.zh: 这公司主要做进口货物的生意。

examples.en: Scientists deal mainly with physical matters.
examples.zh: 科学家处理大多数物理的事物。

mainstream.definition: n. the prevailing current of thought

examples.en: I used to like him, but now he's too mainstream.
The mainstream media is the most prevalent practitioner of scaremongering.
Listening to mainstream music was not a good idea.

maintain.translation: vt. 维持, 维修, 保持, 坚持, 供养, 主张\n[化] 维修

examples.en: When chickens pancake-shape maintain, the tractor must have won again.
examples.zh: 当鸡像煎饼一样平的时候, 那么一定是拖拉机跑得比它们快。

examples.en: Laser printers are generally cheaper to maintain than inkjet printers.
examples.zh: 激光打印机一般比喷墨打印机用起来更省钱。

examples.en: It is hard to maintain one's reputation.
examples.zh: 维持一个人的声誉是很难的。

maintenance.definition: n. means of maintenance of a family or group\nn. the unauthorized interference in a legal action by a person having no interest in it (as by helping one party with money or otherwise to continue the action) so as to obstruct justice or promote unnecessary litigation or unsettle the peace of the community
maintenance.translation: n. 维护, 保持, 维修, 生活费用, 坚持, 扶养\n[计] 维护; 维修

examples.en: He has to pay maintenance to his ex-wife and children.
He was in charge of maintenance at the chocolate factory.
Many archeological sites are at risk due to poor maintenance.

major.definition:
n. a commissioned military officer in the United States Army or Air Force or Marines; below lieutenant colonel and above captain
n. British statesman who was prime minister from 1990 until 1997 (born in 1943)
n. a university student who is studying a particular field as the principal subject
n. the principal field of study of a student at a university
major.translation:
n. 主修课, 成年人, 陆军少校
a. 主要的, 较多的, 大部分的, 成年的, 严重的
vi. 主修
[计] 主要, 主要刻度

examples.en: I decided to go to college to major in English.
examples.zh: 我决定上大学主修英语。

examples.en: The express train will take you between major cities non-stop.
examples.zh: 特快火车会带着你在主要城市穿梭，期间不停。

examples.en: What do you plan to major in at college?
examples.zh: 你计划去大学后主修什么？

majority.definition: n. the property resulting from being or relating to the greater in number of two parts; the main part\nn. (elections) more than half of the votes\nn. the age at which persons are considered competent to manage their own affairs
majority.translation: n. 多数, 大半\n[计] 多数逻辑

examples.en: The majority of his income goes to pay his rent.
examples.zh: 他的大部分收入付了租金。

examples.en: The bill passed by a small majority of 10 votes.
examples.zh: 法案以10票微弱多数通过。

examples.en: Speakers of the dialect are in the majority in this region.
examples.zh: 这一带的方言使用者数量居多。

make.definition:
v. engage in
v. give certain properties to something
v. make or cause to be or to become
v. compel or make somebody or something to act in a certain way
make.translation: vt. 制造, 安排, 创造, 构成, 使得, 产生, 造成, 整理, 布置, 引起, 到达, 进行\nvi. 开始, 前进, 增大, 被制造, 被处理\nn. 制造, 构造, 性情

examples.en: All you have to do is to make a comment.
examples.zh: 你所要做的就是留下意见。

examples.en: Give me a chance to make you proud of me.
examples.zh: 给我机会来让你为我感到自豪。

examples.en: Is it true or did Tom make that story up?
examples.zh: 这是事实还是Tom编的故事？

makeup.definition: n. cosmetics applied to the face to improve or change your appearance\nn. an event that is substituted for a previously cancelled event
makeup.translation: n. 组成, 性格, 化妆品, 化装(术), 虚构, 补考

examples.en: She never wears makeup, but she always looks very charming.
examples.zh: 她从不化妆, 但总是看起来很迷人。

examples.en: Tom doesn't like women who wear too much makeup.
examples.zh: 汤姆不喜欢妆化太浓的女人。

examples.en: You are so beautiful, you do not need to use makeup.
examples.zh: 你很美, 甚至不必使用化妆品。

male.definition:
n. an animal that produces gametes (spermatozoa) that can fertilize female gametes (ova)
n. a person who belongs to the sex that cannot have babies
n. the capital of Maldives in the center of the islands
a. being the sex (of plant or animal) that produces gametes (spermatozoa) that perform the fertilizing function in generation
male.translation: n. 男人, 雄性动物\na. 男性的, 雄性的, 有力的

examples.en: Every male Algerian citizen must do military service.
examples.zh: 每个阿尔及尼亚的男性市民都需要服兵役。

examples.en: I'm not gay, but I like to masturbate with other males.
examples.zh: 我不是同性恋，但是我喜欢和男的一起自慰。

examples.en: I have three dogs. One is male and the other two are female.
examples.zh: 我养了三只狗，一只是雄的，其余两只是雌的。

malfunction.definition: n. a failure to function normally\nv. fail to function or function improperly
malfunction.translation: n. 故障, 失灵, 疾病\nvi. 发生故障, 不起作用\n[计] 故障

examples.en: The repair for the system malfunction lasted for an entire night.
examples.zh: 系统故障的修复工作持续了一整个晚上。

examples.en: This clock seems to be malfunctioning.
examples.zh: 这个时钟似乎坏了。

malice.definition: n. feeling a need to see others suffer
malice.translation: n. 恶意, 蓄意害人, 怨恨\n[法] 预谋, 蓄意, 恶意

examples.en: There was no malice intended in what she said.
examples.zh: 她的话没有恶意。

examples.en: Never attribute to malice that which is adequately explained by stupidity.
examples.zh: 能解释为愚蠢的，就不要解释为恶意。

malicious.definition: a. having the nature of or resulting from malice
malicious.translation: a. 怀恶意的, 恶毒的

examples.en: Nothing will hinder my malicious plan.
examples.zh: 没有什么能阻碍我邪恶的计划。

malignant.definition: a. dangerous to health; characterized by progressive and uncontrolled growth (especially of a tumor)
malignant.translation: a. 有恶意的, 恶性的, 有害的\n[化] 恶性的

examples.en: There are various kinds of tumour, both benign and malignant.
Various types of tumors exist, both benign and malignant.
There are various types of tumors – some benign and some malignant.

mall.definition: n a public area set aside as a pedestrian walk\nn mercantile establishment consisting of a carefully landscaped complex of shops representing leading merchandisers; usually includes restaurants and a convenient parking area; a modern version of the traditional marketplace

examples.en: Sami and Layla want to go to the mall.
examples.zh: 萨米和莱拉想要去商场。

examples.en: Today we went to the shopping mall. I was very bored.
examples.zh: 今天我们去了商城。我很无聊。

examples.en: Recently T Mall has had a sales promotion on cell phones.
examples.zh: 最近天猫上有手机促销活动。

malnutrition.definition: n. a state of poor nutrition; can result from insufficient or excessive or unbalanced diet or from inability to absorb foods
malnutrition.translation: n. 营养失调, 营养不良\n[医] 营养不良

examples.en: Half a million children still face malnutrition in Niger.
examples.zh: 尼日尔仍然有50万孩子面临着营养不良。

mammal.definition: n. any warm-blooded vertebrate having the skin more or less covered with hair; young are born alive except for the small subclass of monotremes and nourished with milk
mammal.translation: n. 哺乳动物\n[化] 哺乳动物

examples.en: The whale is well known to be the largest mammal.
examples.zh: 鲸是被公认为最大的哺乳动物。

examples.en: Beavers may be considered as the busiest mammals on Earth.
examples.zh: 海狸可能被认为是地球上最忙碌的哺乳动物。

examples.en: A dolphin is a kind of mammal.
examples.zh: 海豚是一种哺乳动物。

manage.definition: v. be in charge of, act on, or dispose of
manage.translation: vi. 处理\nvt. 管理, 控制, 维持, 达成, 经营, 运用

examples.en: How did the cat manage to climb on the roof?
examples.zh: 那只猫是怎么爬上屋顶的？

examples.en: How do people manage to sleep on the plane?
examples.zh: 人们怎么能在飞机上睡觉？

examples.en: You should be able to manage it.
examples.zh: 你应该能解决。

management.definition: n. the act of managing something\nn. those in charge of running a business
management.translation: n. 经营, 支配, 管理\n[化] 管理处

examples.en: Management of a company is different from ownership of a company.
examples.zh: 管理一间公司和拥有一间公司是不能相提并论的两回事。

examples.en: Japanese management must learn how to deal with American workers, he said.
examples.zh: 他说：“日本管理层必须学会如何处理美国员工。”

examples.en: The company is starting to implement the new management system from next month.
examples.zh: 公司从下个月开始推行新的管理制度。

manager.definition: n someone who controls resources and expenditures\nn (sports) someone in charge of training an athlete or a team
manager.translation: n. 经理, 管理员, 管理器\n[计] 管理器

examples.en: My manager stared at me as if he was angry.
examples.zh: 经理像是生气了一样盯着我。

examples.en: The fans all hope the club will change the manager.
examples.zh: 球迷们都希望球队能换个教练。

examples.en: Dad said he'd be promoted to section manager next year.
examples.zh: 爸爸说他明年就要被升为部门主管了。

mandate.definition: n. a document giving an official instruction or command\nn. a territory surrendered by Turkey or Germany after World War I and put under the tutelage of some other European power until they are able to stand by themselves\nn. the commission that is given to a government and its policies through an electoral victory
mandate.translation: n. 命令, 指令, 要求\nvt. 委任统治

examples.en: For running for a fifth mandate, Bouteflika damaged his own credibility.
Company regulations mandate that workers wear safety glasses.
Company regulations mandate that workers use protective eyewear.

mandatory.definition: n the recipient of a mandate\nn a territory surrendered by Turkey or Germany after World War I and put under the tutelage of some other European power until they are able to stand by themselves\ns required by rule
mandatory.translation: a. 命令的, 托管的\n[经] 受托者, 命令者

examples.en: A cooking course should be mandatory in schools.
examples.zh: 烹饪课程应该作为学校的必修课。

maneuver.definition: n. a military training exercise\nn. a deliberate coordinated movement requiring dexterity and skill\nn. a move made to gain a tactical end
maneuver.translation: n. 演习, 调遣, 策略\nv. 调遣, 演习, 用计

examples.en: Do you know the Heimlich maneuver?
examples.zh: 你知道海姆利克急救法吗？

examples.en: Sami didn't have time to maneuver.
examples.zh: 萨米没有时间移动。

manifest.definition: n. a customs document listing the contents put on a ship or plane\nv. record in a ship's manifest\nv. reveal its presence or make an appearance
manifest.translation:
n. 载货单, 运货单, 旅客名单
a. 显然的, 明白的
vi. 显示, 出现
vt. 表明, 表现, 证明

examples.en: Spirits of Heaven and Earth, heed my call; manifest swiftly by divine decree!
examples.zh: 天灵灵，地灵灵；急急如律令！

manipulate.definition:
v. influence or control shrewdly or deviously
v. hold something in one's hands and move it
v. control (others or oneself) or influence skillfully, usually to one's advantage
v. treat manually, as with massage, for therapeutic purposed
manipulate.translation: vt. 操纵, 利用, 操作, 巧妙地处理, 假造

examples.en: Some teachers instinctively know how to play “favorites” to manipulate the other students.
examples.zh: 有些老师本能地知道怎么去利用“偏心”去控制其他学生。

mankind.definition: n all of the living human inhabitants of the earth

examples.en: A nuclear war will bring about the destruction of mankind.
examples.zh: 核战争将会为人类带来灭亡。

examples.en: Language is one of the most important inventions of mankind.
examples.zh: 语言是人类最重大的发明之一。

examples.en: The only thing that will redeem mankind is co-operation.
examples.zh: 合作是人类唯一的救赎。

manner.definition: n. how something is done or how it happens\nn. a way of acting or behaving\nn. a kind
manner.translation: n. 样子, 礼貌, 风格\n[法] 方式, 方法, 样式

examples.en: George did business in the same manner as his father.
examples.zh: 乔治和他爸爸做生意的方式一样。

examples.en: I have trouble putting up with his rude manner.
examples.zh: 我受不了他那种无礼的态度。

examples.en: There is nothing worse than doing something in a half-hearted manner.
examples.zh: 没有什么比做事缺乏热情更糟。

manor.definition: n. the mansion of a lord or wealthy person\nn. the landed estate of a lord (including the house on it)
manor.translation: n. 庄园\n[法] 采邑, 庄园, 采地

examples.en: There are apple trees by the windows of the manor.
Karl shared with Rima everything he learnt about the haunted manor.
There are many beds in the manor.

mansion.definition: n. a large and imposing house

examples.en: Compared to our house, yours is a mansion.
examples.zh: 跟我们的房子比，你的就是个豪宅。

examples.en: The mansion was so cheap because it was known to be haunted.
examples.zh: 那别墅因为听说闹鬼所以很便宜。

examples.en: He lived in a big mansion.
examples.zh: 他住在大宅邸里。

manual.definition:
n. a small handbook
a. of or relating to the hands
a. requiring human effort
s. doing or requiring physical work
manual.translation: n. 手册, 指南\na. 手的, 手动的, 手工的, 体力的\n[计] 人工的, 手动的

examples.en: If only I read the user manual properly.
examples.zh: 要是当时有好好读说明书就好了。

examples.en: I'm unable to do manual labour.
examples.zh: 我不能做体力劳动。

examples.en: She was reading a gardening manual.
examples.zh: 她正在读一本园艺手册。

manufacture.definition: v. put together out of artificial or natural components or parts; He manufactured a popular cereal"\nv. produce naturally\nv. create or produce in a mechanical way
manufacture.translation: n. 产品, 制造\nvt. 制造, 假造\nvi. 制造

examples.en: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.
examples.zh: 生产日期在盖子上。

examples.en: You'll have to manufacture some kind of excuse.
examples.zh: 你不得不制造一些借口。

examples.en: We are planning changes to the manufacturing process.
examples.zh: 我们算计着改革生产流程。

manuscript.definition: n. the form of a literary work submitted for publication\nn. handwritten book or document
manuscript.translation: n. 手稿, 原稿, 底稿\na. 手写的

examples.en: He showed me the manuscript of his new play.
examples.zh: 他给我看了他最新剧的底稿。

examples.en: After today, I want to send the manuscript to a publishing house.
examples.zh: 天好以后，我要把稿子送到出版社去。

examples.zh: 我父亲明天会做一桌好菜。

examples.en: Tomorrow, my father is going to make a good meal.
examples.zh: 我父亲明天会做一桌好菜。

mean.definition:
n. an average of n numbers computed by adding some function of the numbers and dividing by some function of n
v. mean or intend to express or convey
v. denote or connote
v. have a specified degree of importance
mean.translation:
a. 低劣的, 卑贱的, 简陋的, 吝啬的, 惭愧的, 平均的, 中间的, 普通的
vt. 意谓, 想要, 意欲, 预定
vi. 用意, 有意义
n. 平均数, 中间, 中庸

examples.en: I mean to go tomorrow if the weather is fine.
examples.zh: 如果天气好的话，我打算明天出发。

examples.en: Can you give an example to explain what you mean?
examples.zh: 你能举例说明你的想法吗?

examples.en: It's written abazure (bitch). Surely this must mean a slut?
examples.zh: 上面写的是「abazure (婊子)」。这肯定是指「荡妇」吧？

meaning.definition: n. the message that is intended or expressed or signified\nn. the idea that is intended\ns. rich in significance or implication
meaning.translation: n. 意义, 含义, 目的, 意图\na. 意味深长的

examples.en: I can't get at the exact meaning of the sentence.
examples.zh: 我抓不到句子的确切含义。

examples.en: I find it difficult to express my meaning in words.
examples.zh: 我觉得很难用言语表达我的意思。

examples.en: The teacher explained the meaning of the word to us.
examples.zh: 老师说明了词的意思。

meaningful.definition: a. having a meaning or purpose

examples.en: She gave me a meaningful look.
examples.zh: 她意味深长地看了我一眼。

examples.en: Everyone listened and was very happy, thinking this wedding was both original and meaningful.
examples.zh: 大家听了，都很高兴，觉得这个婚礼又新颖又有意义。

meantime.definition: n the time between one event, process, or period and another\nr during the intervening time
meantime.translation: n. 间隔时间, 其时\nadv. 其间

examples.en: In the meantime we drank a lot of salt water.
What are you going to do in the meantime?
What would you like to do in the meantime?

meanwhile.definition: r. at the same time but in another place\nr. during the intervening time
meanwhile.translation: n. 其时, 其间\nadv. 同时, 于此时

examples.en: Meanwhile, Jiang Qin distracted Jiang Feng's older brother Yan Daxia.
examples.zh: 与此同时江琴分散了江枫的哥哥燕大侠的注意力。

examples.en: Meanwhile, the circumstances have changed drastically.
examples.zh: 在这期间，情况发生了巨大变化。

examples.en: Meanwhile, conditions have drastically altered.
examples.zh: 在这期间，情况发生了巨大变化。

measure.definition:
n. any maneuver made as part of progress toward a goal
n. how much there is or how many there are of something that you can quantify
n. musical notation for a repeating pattern of musical beats
n. a container of some standard capacity that is used to obtain fixed amounts of a substance
measure.translation: n. 尺寸, 量度器, 量度标准, 测量, 量具, 程度, 范围, 限度, 分寸, 措施, 方法\nvt. 测量, 测度, 估量, 权衡, 调节, 拿(自己或自己的力量等)作较量\nvi. 度量

examples.en: This measure is in accord with our policy.
examples.zh: 这个议案合符我们的政策内容。

examples.en: The government will adopt enforcement measures to solve this problem.
examples.zh: 政府将采取强制措施来解决这一问题。

examples.en: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
examples.zh: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。

mechanic.definition: s. resembling the action of a machine
mechanic.translation: n. 机械工, 技工\na. 手工的

examples.en: Sami has just been to the mechanic.
examples.zh: 萨米刚去找了技工。

examples.en: The mechanic assembled the engine.
examples.zh: 这名技师组装了这台引擎。

mechanical.definition: a. using (or as if using) mechanisms or tools or devices\na. relating to or concerned with machinery or tools\na. relating to or governed by or in accordance with mechanics
mechanical.translation: a. 机械的, 机械性的, 力学的\n[医] 机械的, 力学的

examples.en: I got a piece of lead for my mechanical pencil from her.
examples.zh: 我从她那里拿了一根自动铅笔芯。

examples.en: The result of the invention of the steam engine was that human power was replaced by mechanical power.
examples.zh: 机械力代替人力, 这是蒸汽机发明的结果。

mechanism.definition:
n. the atomic process that occurs during a chemical reaction
n. the technical aspects of doing something
n. a natural object resembling a machine in structure or function
n. (philosophy) the philosophical theory that all phenomena can be explained in terms of physical or biological causes
mechanism.translation: n. 机械, 机构, 结构, 机理, 技巧\n[化] 机理; 历程; 机构

examples.en: Lukas’s defense mechanism kicked in and he started to shoot.
Scientists are slowly piecing together the mechanism of aging.
In what way do they activate this mechanism?

medal.definition: n an award for winning a championship or commemorating some other event
medal.translation: n. 奖牌, 勋章\nvt. 授勋予

examples.en: Who do you think will win the gold medal?
examples.zh: 你们觉得谁会赢金牌？

examples.en: He's been awarded a gold medal once.
examples.zh: 他曾经被授予金牌。

examples.en: Now I am starting to issue copper medals.
examples.zh: 现在我开始发铜牌。

media.definition:
n a means or instrumentality for storing or communicating information
n the surrounding environment
n an intervening substance through which signals can travel as a means for communication
n (bacteriology) a nutrient substance (solid or liquid) that is used to cultivate micro-organisms
n a liquid with which pigment is mixed by a painter
n (biology) a substance in which specimens are preserved or displayed
n an intervening substance through which something is achieved
n a state that is intermediate between extremes; a middle position
n someone who serves as an intermediary between the living and the dead
n (usually plural) transmissions that are disseminated widely to the public
n an occupation for which you are especially well suited

examples.en: For media inquiries, please contact your local communications or marketing representative.
examples.zh: 如需媒体联络，请与当地客服中心或行销团队联系。

examples.en: The media stuck a shiv into his reputation.
examples.zh: 媒体抹黑了他的名誉。

examples.en: Concerning this issue, I feel that the trash media only report biased information.
examples.zh: 关于这个问题，我觉得垃圾媒体只报道了很片面的信息。

median.definition: n. the value below which 50% of the cases fall\ns. relating to or constituting the middle value of an ordered set of values (or the average of the middle two in a set with an even number of values)\ns. relating to or situated in or extending toward the middle
median.translation: a. 中央的, 中间的, 正中的\nn. 正中动脉, 中位数, 中线

examples.en: That guy is all over the median. Is he drunk?
Yuri's truck slid off the road into the median.
Averages come in three flavors: mean, median, and mode.

mediate.definition: v. occupy an intermediate or middle position or form a connecting link or stage between two others\na. acting through or dependent on an intervening agency
mediate.translation: a. 居间的, 间接的\nvt. 斡旋, 调停\nvi. 处于中间, 调解

examples.en: He always tends to mediate in arguments between friends.
The Norwegian diplomat mediated the secret negotiations that produced the historic document.
Interpreters mediate between different cultures.

medical.definition: a. relating to the study or practice of medicine\na. requiring or amenable to treatment by medicine especially as opposed to surgery
medical.translation: n. 医生, 体格检查\na. 医学的, 内科的, 药的

examples.en: Those selected will have to face extensive medical and psychological tests.
examples.zh: 被选上的将会面临大量的医学和精神测试。

examples.en: The company medical treatment insurance covered all the medical treatment costs.
examples.zh: 公司的医疗保险覆盖了全部的医疗费用。

examples.en: Sami has seen every medical show on TV.
examples.zh: 萨米已经看过电视上的每一个医学节目

medication.definition: n. the act of treating with medicines or remedies
medication.translation: n. 药物治疗, 药物处理, 医药\n[医] 药疗法, 投药法

examples.en: I have been taking this medication for many years.
examples.zh: 这种药我吃了好多年了。

examples.en: Tom and Mary need to take their medication.
examples.zh: 汤姆和玛丽要吃药了。

examples.en: I've been taking this medication for many years.
examples.zh: 这种药我吃了好多年了。

medicine.definition: n. the branches of medical science that deal with nonsurgical techniques\nn. (medicine) something that treats or prevents or alleviates the symptoms of disease\nn. the learned profession that is mastered by graduate training in a medical school and that is devoted to preventing or alleviating or curing diseases and injuries
medicine.translation: n. 药, 医学, 内科\nvt. 给...用药

examples.en: Let food be thy medicine and medicine be thy food.
examples.zh: 让你的食物成为药物，药物成为食物。

examples.en: Mother applied the medicine to the sore on my knee.
examples.zh: 母亲把药膏涂在了我膝盖的伤口上。

examples.en: I was told I would feel better after this medicine.
examples.zh: 他们告诉我吃完这个药我就会觉得舒服一点。

medieval.definition: a. relating to or belonging to the Middle Ages\ns. as if belonging to the Middle Ages; old-fashioned and unenlightened
medieval.translation: a. 中古的, 中世纪的

examples.en: Slavic lands were referred to as Canaan in Medieval Hebrew.
The medieval church despised the body and exalted the spirit.
Medieval England buried people alive for merely associating with Jews.

meditation.definition: n. continuous and profound contemplation or musing on a subject or series of subjects of a deep or abstruse nature\nn. (religion) contemplation of spiritual matters (usually on religious or philosophical subjects)

examples.en: Flies and mosquitoes interfered with his meditation.
examples.zh: 苍蝇和蚊子干扰了他的冥想。

medium.definition:
n. a means or instrumentality for storing or communicating information
n. the surrounding environment
n. an intervening substance through which signals can travel as a means for communication
n. a liquid with which pigment is mixed by a painter
medium.translation: n. 媒体, 方法, 媒介\na. 半生熟的, 中间的\n[计] 媒体, 中

examples.en: I believe the medium size will fit you better.
examples.zh: 我认为中号会更适合您。

examples.en: It’s a communication medium, not a substance or specific activity.
examples.zh: 网络是一个相通的渠道，而不是物质或具体的活动。

examples.en: One of my suitcases is large, and the other one is medium.
examples.zh: 我的手提包，一只是大的，另一只是中号的。

meek.definition: s. humble in spirit or manner; suggesting retiring mildness or even cowed submissiveness\ns. very docile\ns. evidencing little spirit or courage; overly submissive or compliant
meek.translation: a. 温顺的, 逆来顺受的

examples.en: Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.
He'd always been a meek and understanding man.
The meek shall inherit the earth.

melancholy.definition: n. a feeling of thoughtful sadness\nn. a constitutional tendency to be gloomy and depressed\ns. characterized by or causing or expressing sadness
melancholy.translation: n. 忧郁, 悲哀, 愁思\na. 忧郁的, 使人悲伤的, 愁思的

examples.en: I don't want to read the Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya.
My passion is the melancholy mournfulness of this meaningless existence.
His face does not express fear, but rather melancholy.

melody.definition: n. the perception of pleasant arrangements of musical notes
melody.translation: n. 曲子, 美妙音乐, 曲调

examples.en: I can't remember the melody of that song.
examples.zh: 我想不起那首歌的旋律。

examples.en: This melody is known to many Japanese.
examples.zh: 很多日本人都知道这段旋律。

examples.en: I've heard that melody somewhere before.
examples.zh: 我之前在哪里听过那段旋律。

melon.definition: n. any of numerous fruits of the gourd family having a hard rind and sweet juicy flesh\nn. any of various fruit of cucurbitaceous vines including: muskmelons; watermelons; cantaloupes; cucumbers
melon.translation: n. 瓜, 甜瓜, 红利, 赃物\n[化] 三聚二氰亚胺

examples.en: They eat melon seeds while they play cards.
examples.zh: 他们一边嗑瓜子，一边打牌。

examples.en: Cut the melon into six equal pieces.
examples.zh: 把瓜切成六等分。

examples.en: I like eating melons from Hami.
examples.zh: 我爱吃哈密瓜。

melt.definition: v. reduce or cause to be reduced from a solid to a liquid state, usually by heating\nv. lose its distinct outline or shape; blend gradually\nv. become less intense and fade away gradually
melt.translation: n. 熔化, 熔化物, 溶解\nv. (使)熔化, (使)溶解, (使)消散, (使)变软

examples.en: The snow will melt when the sun comes out.
examples.zh: 太阳一出来，雪就会融化。

examples.en: The ice-cream will melt, so I put it in the fridge.
examples.zh: 冰淇淋会融化所以我把它放在冰箱里。

examples.en: A plastic dish will melt on the stove.
examples.zh: 塑料盘子在烤箱里会化的。

member.definition: n. one of the persons who compose a social group (especially individuals who have joined and participate in a group organization)\nn. anything that belongs to a set or class\nn. an organization that is a member of another organization (especially a state that belongs to a group of nations)
member.translation: n. 成员, 会员\n[医] │肢, 肢体

examples.en: He became a member of this club five years ago.
examples.zh: 他在五年前成为了这个俱乐部的成员。

examples.en: Kate has become a full member of the royal family.
examples.zh: 凯萨琳已成为皇室的正式成员。

examples.en: Each member has to pay ten thousand yen every month.
examples.zh: 每位会员每月需支付一万日元。

membership.definition: n. the body of members of an organization or group\nn. the state of being a member
membership.translation: n. 会员的资格, 全体会员, 会员数目\n[法] 会员资格, 成员资格, 会籍

examples.en: I applied for membership in the association.
examples.zh: 我申请成为协会会员。

examples.en: There's no membership fee for joining.
examples.zh: 参加不用会员费。

membrane.definition: n. a thin pliable sheet of material\nn. a pliable sheet of tissue that covers or lines or connects the organs or cells of animals or plants
membrane.translation: n. 薄膜, 膜, 羊皮纸\n[化] 膜; 隔膜

examples.en: The doctor has taken a swab from the mucous membrane.
The doctor took a swab of the mucous membrane.
The eardrum is a thin, impermeable membrane.

memo.definition: n. a written proposal or reminder
memo.translation: n. 备忘录\n[经] 备忘录

examples.en: Thanks, I'll file this memo away in the circular file.
The company sent out a memo with an apology for the mistake.
On the memo was scrawled, "have her practice floating in the water."

memoir.definition: n. an account of the author's personal experiences\nn. an essay on a scientific or scholarly topic
memoir.translation: n. 传记, 实录, 追思录, 回忆录, 自传\n[化] 研究报告

examples.en: Yanni published a memoir on his life with Rima.
The memoir breathes the deepest respect for his father.
Tom wrote about having sex with his couch in his memoir.

memorable.translation: a. 值得纪念的, 难忘的

examples.en: It was a memorable evening filled with joy and camaraderie.
What was the most memorable day of your life?
Tell me about a memorable event in your life.

memorial.definition: n. a recognition of meritorious service\nn. a written statement of facts submitted in conjunction with a petition to an authority\nn. a structure erected to commemorate persons or events
memorial.translation: n. 纪念物, 请愿书\na. 记念的, 记忆的

examples.en: The Memorial To The Emperor upon his campaign truly established his renown for all time; Who, in a thousand years, could stand shoulder to shoulder with it?
examples.zh: 出师一表真名世，千载谁堪伯仲间！

memorize.definition: v. commit to memory; learn by heart
memorize.translation: vt. 记住, 熟记, 背熟

examples.en: You should memorize a piece of classical literature every day.
examples.zh: 你必须每天背一篇古典文献。

examples.en: Have you finished your homework? Have you memorized the dictation content?
examples.zh: 这次作业做完了吗？默写背了吗？

examples.en: I've memorized the model number of the charger.
examples.zh: 我把充电器的型号记下了。

memory.definition:
n. something that is remembered
n. the cognitive processes whereby past experience is remembered
n. the power of retaining and recalling past experience
n. an electronic memory device
memory.translation: n. 记忆, 记忆力, 回忆, 纪念, 存储\nn. 内存\n[计] 存储器, 内存, 查看内存实用程序

examples.en: I'd like to find a way to improve my memory.
examples.zh: 我想找一种提升记忆力的方法。

examples.en: Why is my memory so bad? I'm always forgetting things!
examples.zh: 我的记性怎么这么差，总是忘东忘西的！

examples.en: Neither Tom nor Mary has a very good memory.
examples.zh: 汤姆和玛丽的记忆都不好。

menace.definition:
n. something that is a source of danger
n. a threat or the act of threatening
v. express a threat either by an utterance or a gesture
v. act in a threatening manner
menace.translation: n. 威胁, 胁迫\nv. 威吓, 胁迫

examples.en: This kind of bomb is a serious menace to mankind.
Fadil was no longer a menace to society.
Her face was distorted and malignant with menace.

mend.definition: n. sewing that repairs a worn or torn hole (especially in a garment)\nv. heal or recover
mend.translation: n. 改进, 修补, 好转\nvt. 修改, 改进, 加快, 修理\nvi. 好转, 改善

examples.en: How much will it cost to mend this skirt?
examples.zh: 补一下这条裙子要多少钱？

examples.en: He got his wife to mend his shirt.
examples.zh: 他让他的妻子补好衬衫。

examples.en: I asked him to mend my shoes.
examples.zh: 我请他修理我的鞋子。

mental.definition:
a. involving the mind or an intellectual process
a. of or relating to the mind
a. of or relating to the chin- or liplike structure in insects and certain mollusks
s. affected by a disorder of the mind
mental.translation: a. 心智的, 精神病的, 心理的, 颏的\nn. 精神病患者

examples.en: Mental health is as important as physical health.
examples.zh: 精神的健康和身体的健康一样重要。

examples.en: The emigrants have endured physical and mental pain.
examples.zh: 移民们忍受着肉体和精神的痛苦。

examples.en: His trouble was chiefly mental.
examples.zh: 他主要是心理的问题。

mentality.definition: n. a habitual or characteristic mental attitude that determines how you will interpret and respond to situations
mentality.translation: n. 精神力, 智力, 头脑作用, 心态\n[医] 智力

examples.en: Having a competitive mentality can give rise to negative emotions.
examples.zh: 攀比心理会让人产生负面情绪。

mention.definition:
n. a remark that calls attention to something or someone
n. an official recognition of merit
v. make reference to
v. commend
mention.translation: n. 提到, 言及, 陈述\nvt. 提到, 提及

examples.en: I told you not to mention that in her presence.
examples.zh: 我跟你说过她在的时候不要说这件事。

examples.en: Nuclear power plants are dangerous, not to mention nuclear weapons.
examples.zh: 核电厂具危险性，更不用说核武器了。

examples.en: He knows German and French, not to mention English.
examples.zh: 不提英语，他还会说德语和法语。

mentor.definition: n. a wise and trusted guide and advisor\nv. serve as a teacher or trusted counselor
mentor.translation: n. 指导者, 良师益友

examples.en: Antonio is not going to be Rima’s mentor anymore.
I mentor junior developers and train them to be confident.
The apartment is owned by Oleg’s mentor, Walid.

menu.definition:
n. a list of dishes available at a restaurant
n. the dishes making up a meal
n. (computer science) a list of options available to a computer user
n. an agenda of things to do
menu.translation: n. 菜单, (功能)选择单\n[计] 菜单

examples.en: There was a great variety of dishes on the menu.
examples.zh: 菜单上有各种各样的菜色。

examples.en: How many different kinds of pizzas are on the menu?
examples.zh: 菜单上有多少种比萨？

examples.en: I'm sure you'll love what we have on the menu tonight.
examples.zh: 我肯定你会喜欢我们今晚的菜肴。

merchandise.translation: n. 商品, 货物\nv. 交易, 买卖

examples.en: What sort of merchandise do you sell in your shop?
Benedito signed merchandise for fans waiting in the queue.
Please use our toll-free number for calls regarding merchandise.

merchant.definition: n. a businessperson engaged in retail trade
merchant.translation: n. 商人, 店主\na. 商业的, 商人的

examples.en: Merchants only look at the profits.
examples.zh: 商人们只看中利益。

examples.en: Farther from the palace and to its north and south were the commoners, merchants, artisans, and laborers.
examples.zh: 远离宫殿的北方及南方是平民、商人、工艺师傅和工人。

mercury.definition:
n. a heavy silvery toxic univalent and bivalent metallic element; the only metal that is liquid at ordinary temperatures
n. (Roman mythology) messenger of Jupiter and god of commerce; counterpart of Greek Hermes
n. the smallest planet and the nearest to the sun
n. temperature measured by a mercury thermometer
mercury.translation: n. 水银, 汞, 使者\n[化] 汞Hg

examples.en: Tom got mercury poisoning from eating canned tuna every day.
examples.zh: Tom汞中毒，因为他每天吃罐装鲔鱼。

examples.en: Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system.
examples.zh: 水星是我们的太阳系中最小的行星。

examples.en: Tom got mercury poisoning because he ate canned tuna every day.
examples.zh: Tom汞中毒了，因为他每天都吃罐装金枪鱼。

mercy.definition: n. something for which to be thankful\nn. alleviation of distress; showing great kindness toward the distressed
mercy.translation: n. 仁慈, 宽恕, 慈悲, 怜悯, 幸运\n[法] 权宜处置权, 决定权, 宽恕

examples.en: The poor people were at the mercy of the cruel dictator.
examples.zh: 可怜的人民任凭残暴的独裁者处置。

examples.en: In the name of mercy, stop crying.
examples.zh: 行行好，别哭了。

mere.definition: n. a small pond of standing water\ns. being nothing more than specified
mere.translation: n. 小湖, 池塘\na. 仅仅的, 只不过的

examples.en: I'm not a real fish, I'm just a mere plushy.
examples.zh: 我不是一条真的鱼，我只是一个长毛绒玩具。

examples.en: The mere thought of a snake makes me shiver.
examples.zh: 一想到蛇就发颤。

examples.en: Our current crisis is no mere economic crisis.
examples.zh: 我们当前的危机绝非单纯的经济危机。

examples.en: Don't look down on him merely because he is poor.
examples.zh: 不要因为他穷就看不起他。

examples.en: Labor is not merely a necessity but a pleasure.
examples.zh: 劳动不仅是一种需要，而还是一种愉快。

examples.en: Your interpretation is based merely on the surface meaning.
examples.zh: 你的理解有点望文生义了。

merge.definition: v become one\nv mix together different elements\nv join or combine
merge.translation: vt. 使合并, 使消失, 吞没\nvi. 合并, 渐渐消失\n[计] 合并

examples.en: Branching and merging are two basic operations of revision control.
examples.zh: 分支和合并是版本控制的两种基本操作。

examples.en: The Mitsubishi Bank merged with the Bank of Tokyo.
examples.zh: 三菱银行和东京银行合并了。

examples.en: Get into the left lane to make room for the guy who's trying to merge.
examples.zh: 移到左线，为想并入的那辆车腾出空间。

merger.definition: n the combination of two or more commercial companies\nn an occurrence that involves the production of a union
merger.translation: n. 合并, 归并\n[经] 购并

examples.en: The office has been topsy-turvy since the merger upset everything.
examples.zh: 自从公司合并了以后，一切都变得十分混乱。

examples.en: The news of the merger of the two companies broke yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天突然传出了两间公司合并的消息。

merit.definition: n. any admirable quality or attribute
merit.translation: n. 优点, 功绩, 价值, 功过, 真相\nvt. 值得\nvi. 应受

examples.en: Charms strike the sight, but merit wins the soul.
examples.zh: 魅力冲击视觉，美德征服心灵。

examples.en: With all her merits she was not proud.
examples.zh: 她不自豪她所有的优点。

examples.en: Investing money in your home has some merit; when it is time to sell it you can get more money.
examples.zh: 多花点钱在房子上，也有一些好处 ﹣ 例如，卖的时候可以卖个比较好的价钱。

merry.definition: s full of or showing high-spirited merriment\ns offering fun and gaiety\ns quick and energetic
merry.translation: a. 快乐的, 愉快的, 嬉戏作乐的

examples.en: Money won't make you merry, but it eases your misery.
examples.zh: 钞能力不等于幸福，但可以暂时解决很多麻烦。

examples.en: The little girl laughed a merry laugh.
examples.zh: 小女孩高兴地笑了。

examples.en: I wish you a Merry Christmas.
examples.zh: 祝你圣诞节快乐。

mess.definition:
n. a state of confusion and disorderliness
n. soft semiliquid food
n. a meal eaten in a mess hall by service personnel
n. a (large) military dining room where service personnel eat or relax
mess.translation: n. 食堂, 伙食, 用膳, 一份食品, 混乱, 乱七八糟, 困境\nvt. 将...弄糟, 妨碍, 使紊乱, 使就餐\nvi. 陷入困境, 搞乱, 用膳

examples.en: It's a complete mess, and it's getting on my nerves.
examples.zh: 这完全一团乱，让我心烦意乱。

examples.en: My room is a mess. I need to tidy it up.
examples.zh: 我的房间很乱。我必须把它弄整齐。

examples.en: How do I get out of this mess?
examples.zh: 我怎么才能摆脱这种困境？

message.definition:
n. a communication (usually brief) that is written or spoken or signaled
n. what a communication that is about something is about
v. send a message to
v. send as a message
message.translation:
n. 消息, 通讯, 讯息, 教训, 预言, 广告词
vt. 通知
vi. 通报, 报告, 报信
[计] 报文; 消息; 信息

examples.en: Frank left a message by means of a secret code.
examples.zh: 法兰克用暗号留下了一则讯息。

examples.en: Sorry, I was dining and I didn't see the message.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我刚才在吃饭，没有看到信息。

examples.en: Do you think leaving this kind of message is funny?
examples.zh: 你觉得留那种言很好笑吗?

messenger.definition: n. a person who carries a message
messenger.translation: n. 报信者, 使者\n[经] 使者, 送信者, 通信员

examples.en: Moses, peace be upon him, was a messenger of God.
Jesus, peace be upon him, was a messenger of God.
Christ, peace be upon him, was a messenger of God.

metabolism.definition: n. the organic processes (in a cell or organism) that are necessary for life
metabolism.translation: n. 新陈代谢, 变态\n[化] 新陈代谢; 代谢

examples.en: "My metabolism is such that no matter how much I eat I don't put on weight." "Just now, this second, you've made enemies of people throughout the world."
examples.zh: “我就算吃得再多也不会发胖。” “你在那一瞬间成了世界众人的敌人。“

metal.translation: n. 金属, 金属制品, 合金, 本质, 质料\na. 金属制的\nvt. 以金属覆盖

examples.en: Acid acts on things which contain metal.
examples.zh: 酸性会腐蚀含有金属的物质。

examples.en: The value of a coin depends on the weight of the metal used.
examples.zh: 钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。

examples.en: On the mahogany desk, there is a metal cup and a blue coaster.
examples.zh: 在桃花心木的书桌上有著金属的杯子和蓝色杯垫。

metaphor.definition: n. a figure of speech in which an expression is used to refer to something that it does not literally denote in order to suggest a similarity

examples.en: What is the difference between a metaphor and an amphora?
The metaphor of death is a metaphor of violence.
Will Interlingua remain just a fantasy metaphor for you?

meter.definition:
n. the basic unit of length adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites (approximately 1.094 yards)
n. any of various measuring instruments for measuring a quantity
n. (prosody) the accent in a metrical foot of verse
n. rhythm as given by division into parts of equal duration
meter.translation: n. 米, 公尺, 仪表, 计量器\nvt. 以仪表计量

examples.en: I just did a 100-meter sprint and I'm so exhausted.
examples.zh: 我刚百米冲刺，还累得不行呢。

examples.en: His record is a new world record in the 100-meter dash.
examples.zh: 他刷新了百米短跑的世界纪录。

examples.en: I need it for the parking meter.
examples.zh: 我为了停车计时收费器需要它。

method.definition: n. a way of doing something, especially a systematic way; implies an orderly logical arrangement (usually in steps)
method.translation: n. 方法, 办法, 条理, 秩序\n[医] [方]法

examples.en: Scientists have not found a method yet to cure cancer.
examples.zh: 科学家们还没有找到癌症的治疗方法。

examples.en: Actually, the present method has plenty of room for improvement.
examples.zh: 其实现时的方法还有很大的改善空间。

examples.en: This is the best method to solve that problem.
examples.zh: 这是解决那个问题的最佳办法。

methodology.definition: n. the branch of philosophy that analyzes the principles and procedures of inquiry in a particular discipline\nn. the system of methods followed in a particular discipline
methodology.translation: n. 方法学, 方法论\n[化] 操作法; 工艺

examples.en: The proposed methodology is applied to three simulated case studies.
The validation methodology was based also on Bowling's reports.
In his academic paper, Mark introduced his research methodology.

metropolitan.definition: n. in the Eastern Orthodox Church this title is given to a position between bishop and patriarch; equivalent to archbishop in western Christianity\nn. a person who lives in a metropolis\na. relating to or characteristic of a metropolis
metropolitan.translation: n. 大都市居民, 都主教, 宗主国的公民\na. 大都市的, 都主教区的, 宗主国的

examples.en: These four youths share an apartment in the metropolitan area.
How high is the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Office Building?
Tom works as a blood spatter analyst with the metropolitan police.

microbe.definition: n. a minute life form (especially a disease-causing bacterium); the term is not in technical use
microbe.translation: n. 微生物, 细菌\n[医] 微生物

examples.en: You boil water to kill all the microbes in it.
Life is a gift God gave to the first microbes.
The man is also a stubborn microbe.

microphone.definition: n. device for converting sound waves into electrical energy
microphone.translation: n. 扩音器, 麦克风\n[医] 扩音器, 传声器

examples.en: For some reason the microphone didn't work earlier.
examples.zh: 刚才我的麦克风没起作用，不知道为什么。

examples.en: Tom put his hand over the microphone.
examples.zh: 汤姆把手放在麦克风上。

examples.en: The probe is equipped with a microphone.
examples.zh: 探头配有麦克风。

microscope.definition: n. magnifier of the image of small objects
microscope.translation: n. 显微镜\n[化] 显微镜

examples.en: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?
examples.zh: 你知道显微镜和望远镜有甚么分别吗？

examples.en: Do you know who invented the microscope?
examples.zh: 你知道显微镜是谁发明的吗？

examples.en: This microscope magnifies objects by 100 times.
examples.zh: 这台显微镜能把物体放大一百倍。

midst.definition: n. the location of something surrounded by other things

examples.en: Algeria is in the midst of a political crisis.
examples.zh: 阿尔及利亚正处于政治危机中。

examples.en: Algeria is in the midst of an economic crisis.
examples.zh: 阿尔及利亚正处于经济危机中。

examples.en: Even if one is to "believe", there is still a "lie" in the midst.
examples.zh: 就算是believe，中间也藏著一个lie。

mighty.definition: s. having or showing great strength or force or intensity\nr. (Southern regional intensive) very; to a great degree
mighty.translation: n. 有势力的人\na. 有势力的, 强大的, 有力的\nadv. 很, 极

examples.en: You scorned both the Nymphs, who beheld your deeds, and me the mighty Pan.
examples.zh: 你蔑视了目睹你罪行的仙女们，也蔑视了我を这位强大的潘神。

examples.en: She was closely related to the mighty Queen Zurline, and her home was beneath the shade of a widespreading oak.
examples.zh: 她与强大的祖琳女王有著密切的血缘关系，她的家在一棵枝繁叶茂的橡树荫下。

migrate.definition: v. move from one country or region to another and settle there\nv. move periodically or seasonally
migrate.translation: vi. 移动, 移往, 随季节而移居\n[计] 迁移程序

examples.en: The bar-tailed godwit migrates from Alaska to New Zealand.
examples.zh: 斑尾塍鹬从阿拉斯加迁徙至纽西兰。

examples.en: These birds don't migrate.
examples.zh: 这些鸟不转移。

examples.en: The swallows are migrating.
examples.zh: 燕子在迁移。

migration.definition: n. the movement of persons from one country or locality to another\nn. a group of people migrating together (especially in some given time period)\nn. (chemistry) the nonrandom movement of an atom or radical from one place to another within a molecule
migration.translation: n. 移民, 移往, 移动\n[计] 迁移

examples.en: Africa is a continent of migration.
examples.zh: 非洲是转移的大洲。

mild.definition: a. moderate in type or degree or effect or force; far from extreme
mild.translation: a. 温和的, 温柔的, 淡味的, 适度的, 轻微的, (肥皂等)软性的\n[医] 轻的, 缓和的

examples.en: It's fairly mild for this time of year.
examples.zh: 就现在这个节气来说天气是相当温和了。

examples.en: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.
examples.zh: 总体上说，日本的气候温和。

examples.en: We had a mild winter last year.
examples.zh: 去年冬天很暖和。

militant.definition: n. a militant reformer\ns. disposed to warfare or hard-line policies

examples.en: He was the head of the League of Militant Atheists.
The man was said to be part of a rogue militant group.
Ali Ideflawen is a Kabyle militant singer.

military.definition:
n. the military forces of a nation
a. of or relating to the study of the principles of warfare
a. characteristic of or associated with soldiers or the military
a. associated with or performed by members of the armed services as contrasted with civilians
military.translation: n. 军队\na. 军事的, 军人的, 适于战争的

examples.en: The military power of this country is very advanced.
examples.zh: 这个国家的军事力量很先进。

examples.en: The Japanese military forces seemed too strong to stop.
examples.zh: 日本军队看来强大得不可阻挡。

examples.en: The family was highly doubtful of the statement from the military.
examples.zh: 家属对军方的说法高度置疑。

militia.definition: n. civilians trained as soldiers but not part of the regular army\nn. the entire body of physically fit civilians eligible by law for military service
militia.translation: n. 义勇军, 民兵组织, 国民军

examples.en: The militia was formed to defend citizens in an emergency.
Putin's personal militia, the Wagner Group, is a Nazi organization.
The Mahdi Army is a private militia in Iraq.

mill.definition:
n. Scottish philosopher who expounded Bentham's utilitarianism; father of John Stuart Mill (1773-1836)
n. English philosopher and economist remembered for his interpretations of empiricism and utilitarianism (1806-1873)
n. machinery that processes materials by grinding or crushing
v. move about in a confused manner
mill.translation: n. 压榨机, 磨坊, 制造厂\nvt. 碾磨, 磨细, 搅拌, 使乱转\nvi. 乱转, 被碾磨

examples.en: My father worked at a paper mill in his 20s.
My grandfather is using a mill to grind the pepper.
We were at the mill, near the hemp field.

million.definition: n. the number that is represented as a one followed by 6 zeros\nn. a very large indefinite number (usually hyperbole)\ns. (in Roman numerals, M written with a macron over it) denoting a quantity consisting of 1,000,000 items or units
million.translation: n. 百万, 无数\nnum. 百万

examples.en: What would you do if you had a million dollars?
examples.zh: 你有100万美元的话，你会做什么？

examples.en: If you had a million dollars, what would you do?
examples.zh: 你有100万美元的话，你会做什么？

examples.en: Algiers is a bustling city of over three million people.
examples.zh: 阿尔及尔是一座有着超过三百多万人口的繁华都市。

millionaire.definition: n. a person whose material wealth is valued at more than a million dollars
millionaire.translation: n. 百万富翁, 大富豪\n[经] 大资本家, 巨富, 百万富翁

examples.en: He was a millionaire a long time ago.
examples.zh: 很久以前，他是一个百万富翁。

examples.en: He was a millionaire not long ago.
examples.zh: 他不久前是百万富翁。

examples.en: I'd like to be a millionaire.
examples.zh: 我想做一个百万富翁。

mimic.definition: n. someone who mimics (especially an actor or actress)\nv. imitate (a person or manner), especially for satirical effect\ns. constituting an imitation
mimic.translation: a. 模仿的, 摹拟的\nn. 效颦者, 模仿者, 小丑, 仿制品\nvt. 模仿, 摹拟

examples.en: A parrot can mimic a person's voice.
examples.zh: 鹦鹉会模仿人的声音。

mind.definition:
n. that which is responsible for one's thoughts and feelings; the seat of the faculty of reason
n. recall or remembrance
n. attention
n. your intention; what you intend to do
mind.translation: n. 思想, 愿望, 智力, 记忆, 心理, 情绪, 理智, 主意, 心意\nvi. 介意, 注意, 留心\nvt. 注意, 留意, 专心于, 照看, 介意

examples.en: With a firm goal in mind, you will do well.
examples.zh: 有了坚定的目标，你会做得很好。

examples.en: I have too many things on my mind these days.
examples.zh: 这几天我脑袋里的事情太多了。

examples.en: I made up my mind to get married to Margaret.
examples.zh: 我决定要和 Margaret 结婚。

mine.definition:
n. excavation in the earth from which ores and minerals are extracted
n. explosive device that explodes on contact; designed to destroy vehicles or ships or to kill or maim personnel
v. get from the earth by excavation
v. lay mines
mine.translation:
n. 矿, 矿藏, 地雷
vt. 挖掘, 开采, 在...布雷, 破坏
vi. 开矿, 埋设地雷
pron. 我的

examples.en: I met an old friend of mine the other day.
examples.zh: 我那天碰到了我其中的一个老朋友。

examples.en: This trip of mine would need twelve days in total.
examples.zh: 我这趟旅程一共需要十二天。

examples.en: Tom has been a friend of mine for years.
examples.zh: 汤姆是我多年的朋友。

mineral.definition: n. solid homogeneous inorganic substances occurring in nature having a definite chemical composition\na. relating to minerals\ns. composed of matter other than plant or animal
mineral.translation: n. 矿物, 无机物, 苏打水\na. 矿物的, 似矿物的

examples.en: I like to drink natural mineral water.
examples.zh: 我喜欢喝天然的矿泉水。

examples.en: That country is rich in mineral resources.
examples.zh: 那个国家拥有丰富的矿物资源。

examples.en: A mine is where you find precious minerals.
examples.zh: 矿里能找到宝贵的矿物质。

mingle.definition: v. get involved or mixed-up with

examples.en: Ziri didn't want to mingle with other people.
Ziri learnt to mingle with people around him.
Mingle your joys sometimes with your earnest occupation.

miniature.definition: n. painting or drawing included in a book (especially in illuminated medieval manuscripts)\nn. a copy that reproduces a person or thing in greatly reduced size\ns. being on a very small scale
miniature.translation: n. 缩图, 小画像\na. 小规模的, 纤小的

examples.en: He stared at that detailed miniature model of a dinosaur.
Insects are miniature marvels that the planet can't live without.
Rowan loves building miniature figurines of fantastical creatures and machines.

minimal.translation: a. 最小的, 极微的, 最小限度的\n[医] 最小的, 最低的

examples.en: The chance that Tom will mend his ways is minimal.
Green tea undergoes minimal oxidation, preserving its natural green color.
The risk of injury in this sport is minimal.

minimize.definition: v. make small or insignificant\nv. cause to seem less serious; play down
minimize.translation:
vt. 将...减到最少
vt. 最小化
vi. 最小化
[计] 最小化

examples.en: Is there anything we can do to minimize the risk?
We shall try to minimize the risks to the public.
A new initiative strives to minimize the number of accidents.

minimum.definition: n. the smallest possible quantity\nn. the point on a curve where the tangent changes from negative on the left to positive on the right
minimum.translation: a. 最小的, 最低的\nn. 最小值\n[计] 最小值

examples.en: The minimum wage in Okinawa is 642 yen per hour.
examples.zh: 冲绳的最低时薪是每小时642日元。

examples.en: What is the minimum wage in Georgia?
examples.zh: 请问乔治亚洲的最低工资是多少？

examples.en: What's the minimum wage in your country?
examples.zh: 你的国家的最低工资是多少？

minister.definition:
n. a person appointed to a high office in the government
n. a diplomat representing one government to another; ranks below ambassador
n. the job of a head of a government department
v. attend to the wants and needs of others
minister.translation: n. 部长, 牧师, 公使\nvi. 服侍, 救助, 主持宗教仪式

examples.en: This is the house in which the prime minister lives.
examples.zh: 这是总理住的房子。

examples.en: It is rumoured that the Prime Minister will resign next month.
examples.zh: 据传总统下个月要辞职了。

examples.en: He is the prime minister of this country.
examples.zh: 他是这个国家的总理。

ministry.definition:
n. religious ministers collectively (especially Presbyterian)
n. building where the business of a government department is transacted
n. a government department under the direction of a minister
n. the work of a minister of religion
ministry.translation: n. 部, 内阁, 服务\n[经] 部

examples.en: In its "Eleven Five Plan" (2006 to 2010), the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology pledged to implement phone connections in every village and Internet connections in every town.
examples.zh: 信息产业部在其“十一五规划”（二零零六年至二零一零年）中立誓要实现村村通电话，乡乡能上网。

minor.definition:
a. of lesser importance or stature or rank
a. lesser in scope or effect
a. inferior in number or size or amount
a. of a scale or mode
minor.translation:
n. 未成年人, 副修科目
a. 较小的, 二流的, 未成年的
vi. 副修
[计] 次要

examples.en: Can you play the key of C minor?
examples.zh: 你能用C小调演奏吗？

examples.en: He played a minor part in the play.
examples.zh: 他在剧中演了一个小角色。

examples.en: "Moscow Nights" begins with an E minor triad.
examples.zh: 《莫斯科郊外的晚上》以一个E小三和弦开头。

minority.definition: n. a group of people who differ racially or politically from a larger group of which it is a part\nn. being or relating to the smaller in number of two parts\nn. any age prior to the legal age
minority.translation: n. 少数, 未成年, 少数民族\na. 少数的, 属于少数派的

examples.en: April is the national minority health month.
examples.zh: 四月是全国弱势团体医疗月。

examples.en: Han, Manchu, Mongol, Hui and Tibetan people (as well as other minority groups in China) are kins in one family.
examples.zh: 汉满蒙回藏（以及中国的其他少数族裔们）一家亲。

miracle.definition: n. any amazing or wonderful occurrence\nn. a marvellous event manifesting a supernatural act of a divine agent

examples.en: I can hope for a miracle, can't I?
examples.zh: 我能等奇迹发生，是不是？

examples.en: Love is the miracle of civilization.
examples.zh: 爱是人类文明的奇迹。

examples.en: Miracles are called miracles because they don't happen!
examples.zh: 奇迹就是因为不会发生，所以才叫奇迹的嘛。

mirror.definition:
n. polished surface that forms images by reflecting light
n. a faithful depiction or reflection
v. reflect as if in a mirror
v. reflect or resemble
mirror.translation: n. 镜子, 写真, 典范\nvt. 反映, 映出

examples.en: He picked up a mirror and examined his tongue.
examples.zh: 他拿了面镜子细看自己的舌头。

examples.en: Tom and Mary practiced their speeches in front of the mirror.
examples.zh: 汤姆和玛丽对著镜子练习演讲。

examples.en: A mirror wall in the room creates an illusion of spaciousness.
examples.zh: 房间里的镜面墙营造出宽敞的错觉。

mischief.definition: n. reckless or malicious behavior that causes discomfort or annoyance in others
mischief.translation: n. 损害, 伤害, 灾祸, 恶作剧, 淘气\n[法] 损害, 伤害, 危害

examples.en: He likes mischief.
examples.zh: 他喜欢恶作剧。

miserable.definition: s. very unhappy; full of misery\ns. characterized by physical misery
miserable.translation: a. 悲惨的；痛苦的；卑鄙的

examples.en: Kate glanced at Chris and then ignored him, making him feel miserable.
examples.zh: 凯特看了克里斯一眼，然后不理睬他，使他感到痛苦。

examples.en: I'm sick, and it's miserable!
examples.zh: 我生病了，很难受！

misery.definition: n. a state of ill-being due to affliction or misfortune\nn. a feeling of intense unhappiness
misery.translation: n. 痛苦, 悲惨, 不幸, 穷困

examples.en: Money won't make you merry, but it eases your misery.
examples.zh: 钞能力不等于幸福，但可以暂时解决很多麻烦。

examples.en: His illness caused her great misery.
examples.zh: 他的病使她非常伤心。

mislead.definition: v. lead someone in the wrong direction or give someone wrong directions

examples.en: I didn't want to mislead anyone.
examples.zh: 我不想误导任何人。

misleading.definition: v lead someone in the wrong direction or give someone wrong directions\nv give false or misleading information to\ns designed to deceive or mislead either deliberately or inadvertently
misleading.translation: a. 引入歧途的, 使人误解的, 骗人的\n[法] 误写姓名的, 误称的, 令人误解的

examples.en: It's a misleading title.
examples.zh: 这是一个误导性的标题。

missile.definition: n. a rocket carrying a warhead of conventional or nuclear explosives; may be ballistic or directed by remote control
missile.translation: n. 发射物, 导弹, 飞弹, 火箭\na. 可发射的

examples.en: They unveiled new ballistic missiles.
examples.zh: 他们推出了新型弹道飞弹。

mission.definition:
n. an organization of missionaries in a foreign land sent to carry on religious work
n. an operation that is assigned by a higher headquarters
n. a special assignment that is given to a person or group
n. the organized work of a religious missionary
mission.translation: n. 任务, 代表团, 使命, 传教团\nvt. 派遣, 向...传教

examples.en: The American mission is to eliminate communism from the world.
examples.zh: 美国的任务是将共产主义从世界上消除。

examples.en: With their cooperation, the mission had been successfully finished.
examples.zh: 在他们的默契合作下，任务完美地完成了。

examples.en: He was charged with a secret mission.
examples.zh: 他身负机密使命。

missionary.definition: n. someone who attempts to convert others to a particular doctrine or program\nn. someone sent on a mission--especially a religious or charitable mission to a foreign country\na. relating to or connected to a religious mission
missionary.translation: n. 传教士, 负有任务者, 工作人员\na. 传教的, 传教士的

examples.en: In 1807, Robert Morrison, the first British Protestant missionary to China arrived in Guangzhou.
examples.zh: 一八零七年，第一个到中国的英国新教徒传教士罗伯特马礼逊到了广州。

misunderstand.definition: v interpret in the wrong way

examples.en: Tom speaks French so badly that he's often misunderstood.
examples.zh: 汤姆的法文说得很烂，别人经常误会他。

examples.en: I don't want there to be any misunderstanding.
examples.zh: 我不想有任何误会。

examples.en: I feel like she has misunderstood me.
examples.zh: 我觉得她误会我了。

mix.definition:
n. a commercially prepared mixture of dry ingredients
n. an event that combines things in a mixture
n. the act of mixing together
v. combine (electronic signals)
mix.translation: n. 混合物, 混乱, 糊涂\nvt. 使混合, 弄混, 使结合, 混淆\nvi. 相混合, 交往, 参与

examples.en: If you mix blue and red, you'll get purple.
examples.zh: 如果将蓝色和红色混合，就会得到紫色。

examples.en: Add water and mix to a firm dough.
examples.zh: 加水，和成一个结实的面团。

examples.en: Mix the rice and eggs with soy sauce.
examples.zh: 把米饭和鸡蛋及酱油混一下。

mixture.definition: n. (chemistry) a substance consisting of two or more substances mixed together (not in fixed proportions and not with chemical bonding)
mixture.translation: n. 混合, 混淆, 混合物\n[化] 混合物

examples.en: As everyone knows, air is a mixture of gases.
examples.zh: 众所周知，空气是多种气体的混合体。

examples.en: Every opinion is a mixture of truth and error.
examples.zh: 任何意见都是事实与谬误的混合体。

examples.en: Every opinion is a mixture of truth and mistakes.
examples.zh: 所有意见是真相和错误的综合。

moan.definition: n an utterance expressing pain or disapproval\nv indicate pain, discomfort, or displeasure
moan.translation: n. 呻吟, 悲叹\nvi. 呻吟, 抱怨, 悲叹\nvt. 呻吟着说

examples.en: For a while now I've heard them moan all day.
We lament, complain, moan and start crying out in pain.
A long, low moan, indescribably sad, swept over the moor.

mob.definition: n. a disorderly crowd of people
mob.translation: n. 暴民, 民众, 暴徒\nvt. 大举包围, 蜂拥进入, 围攻\nvi. 聚众生事

examples.en: The mob put a price on Tom's head.
examples.zh: 黑帮悬赏捉拿汤姆。

mobile.definition:
n. a river in southwestern Alabama; flows into Mobile Bay
n. a port in southwestern Alabama on Mobile Bay
n. sculpture suspended in midair whose delicately balanced parts can be set in motion by air currents
s. migratory
mobile.translation: a. 移动的, 易变的, 机动的\nn. 活动物体

examples.en: Tom, do you have a mobile phone?
examples.zh: 汤姆，你有手机吗？

examples.en: I need to charge my mobile phone.
examples.zh: 我需要给手机充电。

examples.en: Most young people have a mobile phone.
examples.zh: 年轻人几乎都有手机。

mobility.definition: n. the quality of moving freely
mobility.translation: n. 可动性, 流动性, 机动性\n[化] 迁移率

examples.en: Numidian horsemen had a tremendous degree of mobility and speed.
This area is reserved for people with reduced mobility.
In Kazakhstan, the "academic mobility" project is quite unique.

mobilize.definition: v. make ready for action or use\nv. get ready for war\nv. cause to move around
mobilize.translation: vt. 动员, 调动, 使流通\nvi. 动员

examples.en: We will mobilize all of the lawyers of the company.
Sami was working non-stop to mobilize a search team.
We must mobilize our forces quickly if we wish to succeed.

mock.definition:
n. the act of mocking or ridiculing
v. treat with contempt
v. imitate with mockery and derision
s. constituting a copy or imitation of something
mock.translation:
n. 嘲笑, 戏弄, 模仿
a. 假的, 伪造的, 模拟的
adv. 虚伪地
vt. 嘲弄, 模仿, 使失望, 欺骗, 挫败
vi. 嘲弄

examples.en: The future pilot is trained in a mock cockpit.
examples.zh: 未来飞行员将在模拟操作室中训练。

examples.en: People are most angry when they feel they are being mocked. That's why those who are confident in themselves seldom become angry.
examples.zh: 人们在备感嘲讽时最生气。这也是为何对自己感到自信的人们不容易生气。

mode.definition: n. a particular functioning condition or arrangement\nn. any of various fixed orders of the various diatonic notes within an octave\nn. the most frequent value of a random variable
mode.translation: n. 模态, 调式, 样式, 文体, 状态, 方式, 风尚\n[计] 方式; DOS外部命令:设定各种设备命令

examples.en: This program cannot be run in DOS mode.
examples.zh: 这个程式无法在DOS模式下执行。

model.definition:
n. a hypothetical description of a complex entity or process
n. a type of product
n. a person who poses for a photographer or painter or sculptor
n. representation of something (sometimes on a smaller scale)
model.translation:
n. 模型, 模范, 模特儿
a. 模范的, 作模型用的
vi. 做模型, 做模特儿
vt. 使模仿, 塑造
[计] 模型

examples.en: Tom and Mary participated in a model U.N. conference.
examples.zh: 汤姆和玛丽参加了一个模拟联合国会议。

examples.en: Mike has been making a model plane since breakfast.
examples.zh: 迈克吃完早饭以后一直在做一个模型飞机。

examples.en: I’m interested in the latest model from my favorite brand.
examples.zh: 我对我最爱的品牌最新推出的机型很感兴趣。

moderate.definition:
v. preside over
v. make less fast or intense
a. being within reasonable or average limits; not excessive or extreme
s. not extreme
moderate.translation: a. 适度的, 稳健的, 中等的, 节制的\nvt. 节制, 减轻, 使缓和\nvi. 变缓和, 主持会议

examples.en: Moderate exercise will refresh both mind and body.
examples.zh: 适度的运动让身心焕然一新。

examples.en: Moderate exercise is necessary for good health.
examples.zh: 适度运动对身体健康是必要的。

modern.definition:
n. a contemporary person
n. a typeface (based on an 18th century design by Gianbattista Bodoni) distinguished by regular shape and hairline serifs and heavy downstrokes
a. belonging to the modern era; since the Middle Ages
s. characteristic of present-day art and music and literature and architecture
modern.translation: n. 现代人, 有思想的人\na. 现代的, 时髦的

examples.en: Modern man has moved far away from God and from nature.
examples.zh: 现代人已经偏离上帝和自然了。

examples.en: A computer is a type of modern tool.
examples.zh: 电脑是一种现代工具。

examples.en: Modern art doesn't have an interest in me.
examples.zh: 现代艺术对我没有兴趣。

modernize.translation: vi. 现代化\nvt. 使现代化

examples.en: The modernized version of the qipao is noted for accentuating the female figure.
examples.zh: 现代版旗袍因能突显女人的身材而闻名。

modest.definition:
a. marked by simplicity; having a humble opinion of yourself
s. not large but sufficient in size or amount
s. free from pomp or affectation
a. not offensive to sexual mores in conduct or appearance
modest.translation: a. 谦逊的, 羞怯的, 端庄的, 适度的\n[经] 适当的

examples.en: After winning the Nobel prize, she remained as modest as ever.
examples.zh: 获得诺贝尔奖后，她仍谦虚如昔。

examples.en: Try to be a bit more modest.
examples.zh: 谦虚一点。

examples.en: You are much too modest.
examples.zh: 你太谦虚了。

modification.definition: n. slightly modified copy; not an exact copy\nn. the grammatical relation that exists when a word qualifies the meaning of the phrase
modification.translation: n. 修正, 修饰, 修改\n[化] 修饰; 修改

examples.en: Through genetic modification, we can improve crops.
examples.zh: 通过遗传修饰，我们可以改良农作物。

examples.en: Do not make any modifications before you get confirmations.
examples.zh: 在得到确认之前不要进行任何修改。

examples.en: You need to consider the consequences before making any modifications to existing code.
examples.zh: 对现有代码做出任何修改前，你需要考虑后果。

modify.definition: v. make less severe or harsh or extreme\nv. add a modifier to a constituent
modify.translation: vt. 修正, 变更, 修饰, 缓和, 减轻\nvi. 被修改\n[计] 修改

examples.en: We want to modify the regulations of our school.
examples.zh: 我们想修改学校的规章制度。

examples.en: Things that modify nouns (adjective, or adjectival equivalent).
examples.zh: 修饰名词的东西（形容词，或形容词相等语）。

module.definition: n. detachable compartment of a spacecraft\nn. computer circuit consisting of an assembly of electronic components (as of computer hardware)\nn. a self-contained component (unit or item) that is used in combination with other components
module.translation: n. 组件, 模数\n[计] 模块

examples.en: The crew can enter the underwater vehicle using a plug-in module.
The module has only countably many direct summands up to isomorphism.
With this module you can make the Enter key generate an event.

moist.translation: a. 潮湿的, 多雨的, 感伤的, 含泪的\n[医] 湿的

examples.en: Winds from the sea are moist.
examples.zh: 从海洋吹来的风感觉湿漉漉的。

moisture.translation: n. 湿气, 水分, 降雨\n[化] 含水量; 含湿量

examples.en: If your windows are not airtight, moisture will seep in.
Yes, it is. There's a lot of moisture in the air.
Ziri needs to prevent moisture from getting in there.

mold.definition: n. container into which liquid is poured to create a given shape when it hardens\nn. loose soil rich in organic matter\nn. a fungus that produces a superficial growth on various kinds of damp or decaying organic matter
mold.translation: n. 模子, 模型, 霉\nv. 形成, 塑造, 发霉

examples.en: Yanni's house is full of trash and smells of mold.
She found mold and mildew growing around her kitchen sink.
In other words, people's genetic tendencies actually mold their environments.

molecular.definition: a. relating to or produced by or consisting of molecules\na. relating to simple or elementary organization
molecular.translation: a. 分子的, 由分子组成的\n[医] 分子的

examples.en: This molecular structure is unlike anything I've ever seen.
We will study the underlying molecular occurrences of fertilization.
Benedito's research involves studying the molecular mechanisms of disease.

molecule.definition: n. (physics and chemistry) the simplest structural unit of an element or compound
molecule.translation: n. 分子, 些微\n[化] 分子

examples.en: A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
examples.zh: 一个水分子是由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成的。

moment.definition:
n. a particular point in time
n. an indefinitely short time
n. a turning force produced by an object acting at a distance (or a measure of that force)
n. the n-th moment of a distribution is the expected value of the n-th power of the deviations from a fixed value
moment.translation: n. 片刻, 瞬间, 重要, 阶段, 力矩\n[医] 片刻, 瞬间, 时机, 因素, 矩

examples.en: I do not for a moment think you are wrong.
examples.zh: 我从没认为你错了。

examples.en: Was there a book on the desk a moment ago?
examples.zh: 刚才桌子上有一本书吗？

examples.en: From the moment that I met her, I hated her.
examples.zh: 自从我认识她的时候，我就恨她。

momentum.definition: n. an impelling force or strength\nn. the product of a body's mass and its velocity
momentum.translation: n. 动力, 动量\n[化] 动量

examples.en: As the days passed, our campaign grew in momentum.
Political instability could make Algeria lose its economic momentum.
This is due to conservation of angular momentum.

monarch.definition: n. large migratory American butterfly having deep orange wings with black and white markings; the larvae feed on milkweed
monarch.translation: n. 帝王, 统治者, 元首\n[医] 单原型(植)

examples.en: He is an absolute monarch.
examples.zh: 他是专制君主。

monastery.definition: n. the residence of a religious community

examples.en: I want to be a monk in an ancient monastery.
Sometimes they leave the monastery to stroll through the city.
I'd rather live in a monastery with Internet access.

monetary.definition: a. relating to or involving money
monetary.translation: a. 货币的, 金钱的\n[经] 货币的, 金融的

examples.en: Monetary value is the dominant value in American society.
Anyone can support this project with a monetary donation.
The manufacturing sector is a frenzy over the new monetary policy.

monitor.definition:
n. an ironclad vessel built by Federal forces to do battle with the Merrimac
n. display produced by a device that takes signals and displays them on a television screen or a computer monitor
n. electronic equipment that is used to check the quality or content of electronic transmissions
n. a piece of electronic equipment that keeps track of the operation of a system continuously and warns of trouble
monitor.translation: n. 监督器, 级长, 监听员, 班长, 监视器, 告诫物\nv. 监视, 监听, 监督\n[计] 监视器, 监视程序; 监视

examples.en: Whilst at university, Xiaowang held the post of class monitor.
examples.zh: 上大学的时候，小王担任过班长。

examples.en: The USS Monitor was designated the first National Marine Sanctuary on January 30, 1975.
examples.zh: 莫尼特号战舰于 1975 年 1 月 30 日被指定为美国第一个国家海洋保护区。

examples.en: I'll monitor your progress from my computer.
examples.zh: 我会用我的电脑监察你的进度。

monkey.definition: n. any of various long-tailed primates (excluding the prosimians)
monkey.translation: n. 猴子, 猿, 打桩锤\nvi. 淘气, 胡闹\nvt. 嘲弄

examples.en: It is easy for a monkey to climb a tree.
examples.zh: 对猴子来说，爬树很容易。

examples.en: I'm not talking to you; I'm talking to the monkey.
examples.zh: 我不是在跟你说话，我在跟猴子说话。

examples.en: I'm not talking to you. I'm talking to the monkey.
examples.zh: 我不是在跟你说话，我在跟猴子说话。

monopoly.definition: n. (economics) a market in which there are many buyers but only one seller\nn. exclusive control or possession of something\nn. a board game in which players try to gain a monopoly on real estate as pieces advance around the board according to the throw of a die
monopoly.translation: n. 垄断, 专卖权, 独占事业\n[经] 垄断, 专利品, 垄断(权)独占

examples.en: Monopoly is a popular game for families to play.
examples.zh: 大富翁是一个家庭玩的热门游戏。

examples.en: He was opposed to monopolies.
examples.zh: 他反对垄断。

monotonous.definition: s tediously repetitious or lacking in variety; all work and no play"\ns sounded or spoken in a tone unvarying in pitch
monotonous.translation: a. 单调的, 无变化的

examples.en: I am tired of my monotonous life.
examples.zh: 我厌倦了现在单调的生活。

monster.definition: n. an imaginary creature usually having various human and animal parts\nn. a cruel wicked and inhuman person\nn. (medicine) a grossly malformed and usually nonviable fetus
monster.translation: n. 怪物, 恶人, 巨物\n[医] 畸胎

examples.en: This is not a spider, it's a monster!
examples.zh: 这不是一只蜘蛛，而是一个怪物。

examples.en: A huge monster is coming down the mountain.
examples.zh: 从山上走来一只巨大的怪物。

examples.en: There is a monster under my bed.
examples.zh: 我的床下有怪兽。

monument.definition: n. an important site that is marked and preserved as public property
monument.translation: n. 纪念碑, 纪念物, 石碑

examples.en: Let us go to DC to see the national monument!
There is a monument in the center of the city.
In the center of the park stands a stone monument.

mood.definition: n. verb inflections that express how the action or state is conceived by the speaker
mood.translation: n. 心情, 气氛, 生气, 基调\n[医] 心境

examples.en: Why are you in such a bad mood this morning?
examples.zh: 你今天早上为什么心情这么差？

examples.en: Hot and humid weather puts me in a bad mood.
examples.zh: 天气一闷热，我的心情就不好。

examples.en: Eating ice cream always puts me in a happy mood.
examples.zh: 我一吃冰淇淋就高兴。

moon.definition:
n. the natural satellite of the Earth
n. any object resembling a moon
n. United States religious leader (born in Korea) who founded the Unification Church in 1954; was found guilty of conspiracy to evade taxes (born in 1920)
n. any natural satellite of a planet
moon.translation: n. 月亮, 月球, 月光\nvi. 闲荡\nvt. 虚度

examples.en: The moon is not a good place to live on.
examples.zh: 月球不是一个适合居住的地方。

examples.en: Seen from the moon, the earth looks like a ball.
examples.zh: 从月球上看的话，地球看起来像个皮球。

examples.en: My grandpa believes that the moon landing was a hoax.
examples.zh: 我的祖父相信登月是一个骗局。

moral.definition: n. the significance of a story or event\na. concerned with principles of right and wrong or conforming to standards of behavior and character based on those principles\ns. psychological rather than physical or tangible in effect
moral.translation: n. 道德, 品行, 寓意\na. 道德的, 品性端正的, 精神上的

examples.en: This school sets high moral standards for pupils.
examples.zh: 这个学校对学生的道德标准要求很高。

examples.en: Moral evil is the result of ignorance.
examples.zh: 道德上的恶乃是无知的后果。

examples.en: Public morals are not respected anymore in this town.
examples.zh: 在这座城市里，公共道德不再受到尊重。

morale.definition: n. a state of individual psychological well-being based upon a sense of confidence and usefulness and purpose

examples.en: The morale of those men was excellent.
How are you dealing with employee morale?
The beatings will continue until morale improves.

morality.definition: n. concern with the distinction between good and evil or right and wrong; right or good conduct
morality.translation: n. 道德, 教训, 品行\n[法] 道德, 道义

examples.en: Gentleness and cheerfulness, these come before all morality; they are the perfect duties.
examples.zh: 良善和喜乐比道德更加重要，是我们所应尽的绝对义务。

moreover.definition: r in addition; furthermore, their quality is improving"; moreover, mice nested there"

examples.en: The house looked good; moreover, the price was right.
examples.zh: 屋子物美价廉。

examples.en: It's a cat, and moreover an orange one.
examples.zh: 这是一只猫，而且是一只橘色的猫。

examples.en: Moreover, I can fly.
examples.zh: 此外，我能飞。

mortgage.definition: n. a conditional conveyance of property as security for the repayment of a loan\nv. put up as security or collateral
mortgage.translation: n. 抵押, 约束性义务, 抵押借款\nvt. 抵押, 以...作担保, 把...许给

examples.en: Who can explain to me what a mortgage credit is?
I don't have enough money to pay the mortgage off.
Sami applied for a reverse mortgage to renovate his house.

mosque.definition: n. (Islam) a Muslim place of worship that usually has a minaret

examples.en: This is a house and that is a mosque.
examples.zh: 这是一座房子，那是一座清真寺。

examples.en: He goes to the mosque five times a day.
examples.zh: 他一天去五次清真寺。

examples.en: In Tbilisi, you can find the only mosque in the world where shia and sunni Muslims pray together.
examples.zh: 在第比利斯，你可以看到世界上唯一一座什叶派和逊尼派穆斯林一起祈祷的清真寺。

motion.definition:
n. a change of position that does not entail a change of location
n. a state of change
n. a formal proposal for action made to a deliberative assembly for discussion and vote
n. the act of changing location from one place to another
motion.translation: n. 移动, 手势, 动作, 意向, 请求, 提议\nv. 打手势

examples.en: They looked relieved only when it was in motion.
examples.zh: 当它运转了，他们才看起来放心了。

examples.en: The idea of perpetual motion is an absurd hypothesis.
examples.zh: 永动机这个概念是个荒唐的假说。

examples.en: My father motioned for me to leave the meeting room.
examples.zh: 我父亲示意我离开会议室。

motivate.definition: v. give an incentive for action
motivate.translation: vt. 给与动机, 刺激, 提高...的学习欲望, 促动\n[经] 促动, 激发, 激励

examples.en: It's useless, I'm not motivated today for some reason.
