examples.zh: 不行，今天不知为何没有干劲。

motivation.definition: n. the psychological feature that arouses an organism to action toward a desired goal; the reason for the action; that which gives purpose and direction to behavior\nn. the condition of being motivated\nn. the act of motivating; providing incentive
motivation.translation: n. 动机, 刺激, 推动\n[医] 促动, 推动, 诱导

examples.en: When real life friends desert us, books are always ready to offer friendship, sympathy and motivation.
examples.zh: 生活中的朋友弃我们不顾之时，书随时给我们送来友谊、同情和鼓励。

motive.definition: s. causing or able to cause motion
motive.translation: n. 动机, 目的, 主题, 基调\na. 运动的, 成为动机的

examples.en: What was his motive for doing it?
examples.zh: 他那样做有甚么动机？

examples.en: Jealousy was the motive for the murder.
examples.zh: 嫉妒是谋杀的动机。

examples.en: What's his motive for committing murder?
examples.zh: 他杀人的动机是甚么？

motor.definition: n. machine that converts other forms of energy into mechanical energy and so imparts motion\nn. a nonspecific agent that imparts motion
motor.translation:
n. 马达, 发动机, 原动力, 汽车
a. 马达的, 发动机的, 汽车的, 发动的
vt. 推动, 以汽车载运
vi. 乘汽车, 驾车

examples.en: The number of motor vehicles in the city has increased.
examples.zh: 城市里的机动车数量增加了。

examples.en: Is there a problem with the motor?
examples.zh: 发动机出问题了吗？

motto.definition: n. a favorite saying of a sect or political group
motto.translation: n. 箴言, 座右铭, 警句

examples.en: Leonid came up with a new motto for the company.
Tom always went by the motto "live and let live."
My motto is: Comfort the afflicted and afflict the comfortable.

mount.definition:
n. a mounting consisting of a piece of metal (as in a ring or other jewelry) that holds a gem in place
v. attach to a support
v. fix onto a backing, setting, or support
v. put up or launch
mount.translation:
n. 乘骑用马, 框, 衬纸, 山
vi. 乘马, 爬上, 增长
vt. 爬上, 使上马, 装上, 装裱, 安放, 制作...的标本, 设置, 上演
[计] 安装

examples.en: In clear weather one can see Mount Fuji from here.
examples.zh: 在晴朗的日子里，可以从这看见富士山。

examples.en: The jeweler mounted a big pearl in the brooch.
examples.zh: 宝石师傅在胸针上镶了一枚大珍珠。

examples.en: She is going to Mount Tate.
examples.zh: 她将去立山。

mountain.definition: n. a land mass that projects well above its surroundings; higher than a hill
mountain.translation: n. 山, 山脉, 大堆

examples.en: Did you know that some foxes lived on this mountain?
examples.zh: 你知道有些狐狸住在这座山上吗?

examples.en: This famous mountain climber is a critic of mass tourism.
examples.zh: 这位著名的登山家批评大众旅游。

examples.en: Her house is at the foot of a mountain.
examples.zh: 她家在一座山的山脚下。

mourn.definition: v. feel sadness\nv. observe the customs of mourning after the death of a loved one
mourn.translation: v. 哀悼, 忧伤, 服丧

examples.en: The widow mourned for her husband for a long time.
examples.zh: 寡妇为她的丈夫哀悼了很久。

examples.en: The widow mourned her husband for a long time.
examples.zh: 寡妇为她的丈夫哀悼了很久。

examples.en: Tom is in mourning.
examples.zh: 汤姆正在哀悼。

movement.definition:
n. a natural event that involves a change in the position or location of something
n. a group of people with a common ideology who try together to achieve certain general goals
n. a major self-contained part of a symphony or sonata
n. the driving and regulating parts of a mechanism (as of a watch or clock)
movement.translation: n. 运动, 动作, 运转, 移动, 倾向, 变化, 活动, 乐章\n[医] 运动

examples.en: Your son took part in the student movement, I hear.
examples.zh: 听说你儿子参与了学生运动。

examples.en: Avoid sudden movements around the rabbit, they can startle them.
examples.zh: 避免在兔子旁边突然做出动作，以免吓到牠们。

examples.en: In the 1960s, the civil rights movement emerged in the United States.
examples.zh: 一九六零年代，美国兴起民权运动。

multiple.definition: n. the product of a quantity by an integer\na. having or involving or consisting of more than one part or entity or individual
multiple.translation: n. 倍数, 并联\na. 多样的, 许多的, 多功能的

examples.en: Completing this project would require the cooperation of multiple parties.
examples.zh: 这个项目要多方合作才能完成。

examples.en: Don't include multiple alternative words inside the same sentence.
examples.zh: 在同一句中不要包含多个可选单词。

examples.en: He is charged with multiple property crimes.
examples.zh: 他被指控犯有好几起侵犯财产罪。

multiply.definition: v. combine by multiplication\nv. combine or increase by multiplication\nr. in several ways; in a multiple manner
multiply.translation: v. 繁殖, 乘, 增加\n[计] 乘

examples.en: Four multiplied by two is eight.
examples.zh: 四乘以二等于八。

examples.en: Six multiplied by three is eighteen.
examples.zh: 六乘三等于十八。

examples.en: What is two to the power of four multiplied by three plus four squared plus three?
examples.zh: 2的4次方乘3加4的平方加3是多少？

municipal.definition: a. relating or belonging to or characteristic of a municipality\ns. of or relating to the government of a municipality
municipal.translation: a. 市政的, 自治区的, 内政的\n[经] 市政的, 市的

examples.en: There are still large swaths of municipal land left unused.
William is running for re-election in the upcoming municipal elections.
Today three grand pianos appears at the municipal dump.

murder.definition: n. unlawful premeditated killing of a human being by a human being\nv. kill intentionally and with premeditation
murder.translation: n. 谋杀\nvt. 谋杀, 损毁, 破坏\nvi. 犯杀人罪

examples.en: The court declared him innocent on the charge of murder.
examples.zh: 法庭对他的谋杀罪名作出了无罪判决。

examples.en: He has spent ten years in jail for murder.
examples.zh: 他因为谋杀案在牢里待了十年。

examples.en: The murder happened between 3 a.m. and 5 a.m.
examples.zh: 凶杀案于凌晨三到五点间发生。

murmur.definition: v. speak softly or indistinctly\nv. make complaining remarks or noises under one's breath
murmur.translation: n. 低语, 低声的怨言\nvi. 低语, 低声而言\nvt. 低声说

examples.en: The murmur of the brook lulls me to sleep.
examples.zh: 溪流潺潺，催我入眠。

examples.en: In the distance I hear the sound of softly murmuring roads.
examples.zh: 我听到轻柔的沙沙声从远方的路上传来。

examples.en: The shy boy murmured his name.
examples.zh: 羞怯的男孩呢喃地说出自己的名字。

muscle.definition:
n. one of the contractile organs of the body
n. animal tissue consisting predominantly of contractile cells
n. authority or power or force (especially when used in a coercive way)
v. make one's way by force
muscle.translation: n. 肌肉, 臂力\n[医] 肌

examples.en: Courage is very important. Like a muscle, it is strengthened by use.
examples.zh: 勇气是非常重要的。比如肌肉，经常使用才得以加强。

examples.en: You have to stretch your muscles after swimming in the pool.
examples.zh: 在泳池游完泳后要拉伸肌肉。

examples.en: The cat didn't move a muscle.
examples.zh: 小猫一动也不动。

museum.definition: n. a depository for collecting and displaying objects having scientific or historical or artistic value

examples.en: He donated a large pile of items to the museum.
examples.zh: 他将一大堆东西捐赠给博物馆。

examples.en: The museum had to close due to lack of finances.
examples.zh: 博物馆资金不足，只好关门。

examples.en: How far is it from here to the museum?
examples.zh: 这里离博物馆多远？

mushroom.definition:
n. common name for an edible agaric (contrasting with the inedible toadstool)
n. mushrooms and related fleshy fungi (including toadstools, puffballs, morels, coral fungi, etc.)
n. any of various fleshy fungi of the subdivision Basidiomycota consisting of a cap at the end of a stem arising from an underground mycelium
n. a large cloud of rubble and dust shaped like a mushroom and rising into the sky after an explosion (especially of a nuclear bomb)
mushroom.translation: n. 蘑菇形物, 蘑菇, 暴发户\nvi. 迅速生长, 迅速增加, 采蘑菇\na. 蘑菇形的, 迅速生长的

examples.en: I especially like the flavour of the mushroom.
examples.zh: 我特别喜欢蘑菇的味道。

examples.en: Tom and Mary went into the forest to collect mushrooms.
examples.zh: 汤姆和玛丽亚到树林里采集蘑菇去了。

examples.en: I made mushroom soup.
examples.zh: 我做了蘑菇汤。

music.definition:
n. an artistic form of auditory communication incorporating instrumental or vocal tones in a structured and continuous manner
n. any agreeable (pleasing and harmonious) sounds
n. musical activity (singing or whistling etc.)
n. (music) the sounds produced by singers or musical instruments (or reproductions of such sounds)

examples.en: I am not so fond of music as you are.
examples.zh: 我没有你那么喜欢音乐。

examples.en: Music is well said to be the speech of angels.
examples.zh: 人们说得好，音乐是天使的话语。

examples.en: My sister likes classical music no less than I do.
examples.zh: 我姊姊对古典音乐的热爱不亚于我。

mute.definition: n. a deaf person who is unable to speak\nn. a device used to soften the tone of a musical instrument\ns. expressed without speech
mute.translation:
n. 哑子, 哑音字母, 弱音器
a. 哑的, 无声的, 沉默的
vt. 减弱...的声音
vi. 排泄

examples.en: Helen Keller was blind, deaf and mute.
examples.zh: 海伦·凯勒眼盲、耳聋并且不能说话。

examples.en: She was blind, deaf, and mute.
examples.zh: 她又盲又聋又哑。

examples.en: Tom is deaf and mute.
examples.zh: 汤姆是聋哑人。

mutual.definition: s common to or shared by two or more parties\na concerning each of two or more persons or things; especially given or done in return
mutual.translation: a. 相互的, 共有的\n[经] 相互的

examples.en: They want to talk to you about areas of mutual interest.
examples.zh: 他们想和你互相谈谈共同的兴趣领域。

examples.en: True friendship is based on mutual trust.
examples.zh: 真正的友谊建立在彼此信任的基础上。

examples.en: Our love is mutual.
examples.zh: 我们的爱是相互的。

mystery.definition: n. something that baffles understanding and cannot be explained\nn. a story about a crime (usually murder) presented as a novel or play or movie
mystery.translation: n. 秘密, 神秘, 奥秘

examples.en: This letter is the only key to the mystery.
examples.zh: 这封信是揭开谜团的唯一线索。

examples.en: The cause of his death still remains a mystery.
examples.zh: 他的死因仍然是一个谜。

examples.en: What happened to them is still a mystery.
examples.zh: 在他们身上发生了什么仍然是个谜。

myth.definition: n. a traditional story accepted as history; serves to explain the world view of a people
myth.translation: n. 神话, 虚构的事, 虚构的人

examples.en: The myth offers insights into the ancient civilization.
examples.zh: 神话让我们能透悉古文明。

examples.en: Myths and legends should be handed down from generation to generation.
examples.zh: 神话和传说应该一代一代的传承下去。

examples.en: Paul's success was a myth.
examples.zh: 保罗的成功是一个神话。

mythology.definition: n. myths collectively; the body of stories associated with a culture or institution or person\nn. the study of myths

examples.en: In Greek mythology, Ares was the god of war.
examples.zh: 在希腊神话中，阿瑞斯是战争之神。

magnate.definition: n a very wealthy or powerful businessman
magnate.translation: n. 大官, 巨头\n[法] 大官, 权贵, 大资本家

examples.en: Sami was an Egyptian shipping magnate.
Miroslav is a business magnate.
He is a magnate.

majestic.definition: s. majestic in manner or bearing; superior to mundane matters
majestic.translation: a. 宏伟的, 庄严的

examples.en: This majestic mountain range in the heart of south Asia is crowned with snowcapped peaks and draped with vast glaciers.
examples.zh: 这座位于南亚中心的雄伟山脉，山峰白雪皑皑，覆盖著广阔的冰川。

malady.definition: n. any unwholesome or desperate condition
malady.translation: n. 病, 疾病, 弊病\n[医] 病

examples.en: The doctor said that this malady is untreatable.
The malady of our time is perfectionism.
Travelers can suffer from any number of maladies in foreign lands.

mantle.definition:
n. the cloak as a symbol of authority
n. United States baseball player (1931-1997)
n. the layer of the earth between the crust and the core
n. (zoology) a protective layer of epidermis in mollusks or brachiopods that secretes a substance forming the shell
mantle.translation: n. 斗篷, 罩子, 披风\nvt. 罩住, 覆盖\nvi. 覆盖, 脸红

examples.en: Tick-tock, tick-tock! They kept winding the clock on the mantle.
Scientists believe that Ceres has a rocky core and an icy mantle.
A blush still mantled on Lucy Ashton's beautiful cheek.

maritime.definition: s. bordering on or living or characteristic of those near the sea
maritime.translation: a. 海的, 海上的, 海事的, 沿海的, 海员的\n[经] 海事的, 海上的, 海员的

examples.en: Boeing developed a flying boat for the Maritime Self-Defense Force.
Is there a difference between admiralty and maritime law?
Japan is a maritime nation surrounded on all sides by ocean.

martial.definition: n. Roman poet noted for epigrams (first century BC)\ns. of or relating to the armed forces
martial.translation: a. 战争的, 军事的, 尚武的, 威武的\n[医] 含铁的

examples.en: His martial arts prowess has already reached a level of sublime perfection.
examples.zh: 他的武功已经达到了出神入化的境界。

maternity.definition: n the state of being pregnant; the period from conception to birth when a woman carries a developing fetus in her uterus\nn the kinship relation between an offspring and the mother\nn the quality of having or showing the tenderness and warmth and affection of or befitting a mother
maternity.translation: n. 母性, 怀孕, 妇产科医院\na. 产妇的

examples.en: Little Wang is on maternity leave. She won't be back to work for six months.
examples.zh: 小王休产假了，半年内都不会来上班。

maze.definition: n. complex system of paths or tunnels in which it is easy to get lost
maze.translation: n. 迷宫, 迷惘\nvt. 使迷惘, 使混乱, 迷失

examples.en: It's easy to get lost in this maze of alleyways.
I finally found my way out of the confusing maze.
The centipede twisted and turned through the maze of roots.

meditate.definition: v reflect deeply on a subject\nv think intently and at length, as for spiritual purposes
meditate.translation: vt. 想, 考虑, 计划\nvi. 沉思, 反省

examples.en: He used to meditate in the morning.
examples.zh: 他过去时常在早上的时候冥想。

examples.en: He was meditating on his future life.
examples.zh: 他正在思考他未来的生活。

mercenary.definition: n. a person hired to fight for another country than their own\ns. serving for wages in a foreign army
mercenary.translation: n. 唯利是图者, 雇佣兵\na. 为钱而工作的, 被雇的, 图利的

examples.en: "Yanni was a mercenary." "Pardon me?" "He was a killer."
As a mercenary, did you participate in torture sessions?
He was in command of the mercenary force.

metabolic.definition: a. of or relating to metabolism\na. undergoing metamorphosis
metabolic.translation: a. 变化的, 变形的, 新陈代谢的\n[医] [新陈]代谢的

examples.en: Tom suffers from various metabolic disorders.
To assess metabolic health, doctors measure blood sugar, cholesterol, blood pressure and other indicators.
Positron Emission Tomography uses a radioactive tracer to visualize metabolic activity within the human body.

metallic.definition: n. a fabric made of a yarn that is partly or entirely of metal\nn. a yarn made partly or entirely of metal\na. containing or made of or resembling or characteristic of a metal
metallic.translation: a. 金属的, 含金属的, 产生金属的\n[经] 金属的

examples.en: Tea, drunk from a new thermos, tastes a little metallic.
Layla could smell that metallic iron smell of blood.
Lorenzo heard some sort of metallic thud coming from the outside.

meteor.definition: n. a streak of light in the sky at night that results when a meteoroid hits the earth's atmosphere and air friction causes the meteoroid to melt or vaporize or explode
meteor.translation: n. 流星, 大气现象

examples.en: Tomorrow we are going to see the meteor shower!
examples.zh: 明天要看流星雨啊！

meticulous.definition: s. marked by precise accordance with details\ns. marked by extreme care in treatment of details
meticulous.translation: a. 一丝不苟的, 精确的, 过细的

examples.en: Sami had a meticulous eye for choosing the right clothes.
You think in a way that is very meticulous.
Tom is so meticulous in his choice of food.

metropolis.definition: n a large and densely populated urban area; may include several independent administrative districts\nn people living in a large densely populated municipality
metropolis.translation: n. 大都市, 重要中心, 首府\n[医] 产地, 生地

examples.en: Many of Europe's metropolises are plagued by the donut phenomenon.
examples.zh: 许多欧洲的大都市饱受“甜甜圈现象”困扰。

examples.en: Many of Europe's metropolises are plagued by the doughnut phenomenon.
examples.zh: 许多欧洲的大都市饱受“甜甜圈现象”困扰。

mitigate.definition: v. make less severe or harsh
mitigate.translation: vt. 温和, 缓和, 减轻\n[医] 缓和, 减轻

examples.en: There are measures you can take to mitigate clumping.
Machine learning can be used to predict and mitigate natural disasters.
What can be done to mitigate the risk?

moat.definition: n. ditch dug as a fortification and usually filled with water
moat.translation: n. 壕沟, 护城河\nvt. 将...围以壕沟

examples.en: The river outside of the castle is called a moat.
examples.zh: 城堡外面的河叫做护城河。

moratorium.definition: n. a legally authorized postponement before some obligation must be discharged\nn. suspension of an ongoing activity
moratorium.translation: n. 延期偿付, 暂停\n[法] 延期偿付, 延缓履行, 延期偿还期

examples.en: A moratorium has been placed on discussing this topic.
The government declared a moratorium on all debt payments.
Scientists and environmentalists are urging an international moratorium on deep-sea mining.

mosaic.definition:
n. art consisting of a design made of small pieces of colored stone or glass
n. viral disease in solanaceous plants (tomatoes, potatoes, tobacco) resulting in mottling and often shriveling of the leaves
n. a freeware browser
n. a pattern resembling a mosaic
mosaic.translation:
n. 马赛克, 镶嵌细工, 镶嵌工艺
a. 马赛克的, 镶嵌细工的, 拼花的
vt. 用镶嵌细工装饰
[计] Mosaic浏览程序

examples.en: Please ensure the genitals are obscured by a mosaic effect.
The world of thinking is a mosaic of visions, expressed through language.
This is a glass mosaic.
The motel can accommodate as many as 400 guests.
examples.zh: 汽车旅馆可以接待多达400名客人。

examples.en: It was in 1832 that Evariste Galois fell in love with Stephanie-Felicie Poterin du Motel.
examples.zh: 1832年Evariste Galois和Stephanie-Felicie Poterin du Motel陷入热恋。

moth.definition: n. typically crepuscular or nocturnal insect having a stout body and feathery or hairlike antennae
moth.translation: n. 蛾害, 蛾, 乌头叶菜豆\n[医] 蠹, 蛾

examples.en: Is it a butterfly or a moth?
examples.zh: 这是一只蝴蝶还是一只飞蛾？

examples.en: The scent of cedar repels moths.
examples.zh: 雪松的气味可以驱赶飞蛾。

examples.en: Moths are attracted by light.
examples.zh: 飞蛾被光线吸引。

mundane.definition: s. concerned with the world or worldly matters\ns. belonging to this earth or world; not ideal or heavenly; yet a mundane wonder of unimagined kind"
mundane.translation: a. 现世的, 世俗的, 宇宙的

examples.en: Sadako realized that, near death, even what was once mundane glows with an everlasting beauty.
examples.zh: 贞子意识到，在生命将尽之际，曾经平凡无奇的事物，也会散发永恒的美。

mural.definition: n. a painting that is applied to a wall surface\na. of or relating to walls
mural.translation: a. 壁的, 壁上的, 壁似的\nn. 壁画

examples.en: Is that a mural of the building it's painted on?
She works on a large mural in the city.
He painted a colorful mural on the wall.

muster.definition: n. a gathering of military personnel for duty\nv. gather or bring together\nv. call to duty, military service, jury duty, etc.
muster.translation: n. 召集, 集合, 检阅, 清单, 花名册, 样品\nvt. 召集, 集合, 应召\nvi. 集合, 集中

examples.en: I mustered up my courage and went there.
examples.zh: 我硬着头皮去了。

myriad.translation: n. 无数, 无数的人(或物)\na. 无数的, 种种的

examples.en: The night sky was filled with a myriad of stars.
There are myriad reasons why this project might fail.
We entered this world to experience life in its myriad forms.

malware.translation: n. 恶意软件; 恶意软件。malware是malicious software的合成形式; 流氓软件

examples.en: The Iranian nuclear program has just been attacked by malware.
Don't download files from unknown sources; it could be malware.
The site was taken down because it contained malware.

mattress.definition: n. a large thick pad filled with resilient material and often incorporating coiled springs, used as a bed or part of a bed
mattress.translation: n. 床垫, 空气垫, 沉床\n[医] 褥子, 床垫

examples.en: My brother hides his porn magazines under his mattress.
examples.zh: 我的兄弟把色情杂志藏在床垫下面。

examples.en: Tom hid his money under his mattress.
examples.zh: 汤姆把钱藏在床垫底下。

examples.en: This is a very hard mattress.
examples.zh: 这个床垫很硬。

mosquito.definition: n. two-winged insect whose female has a long proboscis to pierce the skin and suck the blood of humans and animals

examples.en: I got a lot of mosquito bites.
examples.zh: 我被很多的蚊子叮了。

examples.en: I just got bitten by a mosquito.
examples.zh: 我刚刚被蚊子咬了。

examples.en: The good thing about winter is that there are no mosquitos.
examples.zh: 冬天的好处在于没有蚊子。

mustard.definition: n. any of several cruciferous plants of the genus Brassica\nn. pungent powder or paste prepared from ground mustard seeds\nn. leaves eaten as cooked greens
mustard.translation: n. 芥末, 芥菜, 强烈的兴趣\n[医] 芥子; 芥属植物

examples.en: A drop of mustard fell and stained my tie during lunch.
examples.zh: 吃午饭的时候，一坨芥末酱滴下来弄脏了我的领带。

examples.en: Easy on the mustard.
examples.zh: 不要加太多芥末。

matrix.definition:
n. (mathematics) a rectangular array of quantities or expressions set out by rows and columns; treated as a single element and manipulated according to rules
n. (geology) amass of fine-grained rock in which fossils, crystals, or gems are embedded
n. an enclosure within which something originates or develops (from the Latin for womb)
n. the body substance in which tissue cells are embedded
matrix.translation: n. 母体, 子宫, 基质, 脉石, 模型, 矩阵\n[计] 矩阵

examples.en: The inverse of a non-square matrix is a dangerous thing.
examples.zh: 非方矩阵的逆阵是一个危险的东西。

meteorite.definition: n. stony or metallic object that is the remains of a meteoroid that has reached the earth's surface
meteorite.translation: n. 陨星\n[化] 陨石; 陨铁

examples.en: The meteorite fragmented as it entered the Earth's atmosphere.
This hole was formed by a falling meteorite.
This meteorite was found in the Sahara Desert.

monsoon.definition: n. a seasonal wind in southern Asia; blows from the southwest (bringing rain) in summer and from the northeast in winter\nn. rainy season in southern Asia when the southwestern monsoon blows, bringing heavy rains\nn. any wind that changes direction with the seasons
monsoon.translation: n. 季风, 吹季风的季节, 雨季

examples.en: This is the monsoon season.
examples.zh: 这是季风季节。

mango.definition: n. large evergreen tropical tree cultivated for its large oval fruit\nn. large oval tropical fruit having smooth skin, juicy aromatic pulp, and a large hairy seed
mango.translation: n. 芒果\n[化] 芒果Mangifera indica

examples.en: I am looking for a mango to eat.
examples.zh: 我在找芒果吃。

examples.en: I want to eat mango.
examples.zh: 我想吃芒果。

examples.en: Daniel is making mango juice.
examples.zh: Daniel正在做芒果汁。

moose.definition: n large northern deer with enormous flattened antlers in the male; called `elk' in Europe and `moose' in North America

examples.en: There was a moose in the middle of the road.
Moose antlers can grow up to six feet in length.
The moose is the largest member of the deer family.

mandolin.definition: n. a stringed instrument related to the lute, usually played with a plectrum

examples.en: I don't play the mandolin as well as you do.
I have a mandolin that look a lot like Tom's.
I thought that Tom knew how to play the mandolin.

mainland.definition: n. the main land mass of a country or continent; as distinguished from an island or peninsula
mainland.translation: n. 大陆, 本土\n[法] 大陆

examples.en: Tomorrow, I am coming back from Hong Kong to the mainland.
examples.zh: 明天我要从香港去趟内地。

manufacturer.definition: n. a business engaged in manufacturing some product\nn. someone who manufactures something
manufacturer.translation: n. 制造业者, 厂商\n[经] 制造人, 制造商, 制造厂

examples.en: Can you find the manufacturer of the faucet for warranty?
The manufacturer of the television set is a Japanese company.
The manufacturer of the medicine is a Japanese company.

magnificence.definition: n. the quality of being magnificent or splendid or grand
magnificence.translation: n. 富丽堂皇, 华丽, 宏大

examples.en: Have you noticed the magnificence of French cathedrals?

majesty.definition: n impressiveness in scale or proportion
majesty.translation: n. 最高权威, 威严, 王权, 雄伟, 庄严

examples.en: Your Majesty, open the door. It is cold out here.
Would Your Majesty care for a walk in the gardens?
I said to the king: Your Majesty, please forgive me!

malpractice.definition: n. professional wrongdoing that results in injury or damage\nn. a wrongful act that the actor had no right to do; improper professional conduct
malpractice.translation: n. 不当治疗, 不端行为, 渎职\n[医] 疗法失当, 医疗差错

examples.en: The doctor who treated Tom should be sued for malpractice.
Malpractice insurance is a contributing factor to the high cost of medical care.
I sued my doctor for malpractice.

manhood.definition: n. the state of being a man; manly qualities\nn. the status of being a man
manhood.translation: n. 成年, 勇气, 男儿\n[法] 成年身分, 成年, 男子

examples.en: Yanni was a very tall guy and he oozed manhood.
Claus, however, being mortal, grew to manhood day by day.
Most athletes are at their best during their early manhood.

manly.definition: a. possessing qualities befitting a man
manly.translation: a. 象男人的, 强壮的, 适于男人的

examples.en: It is not manly to speak ill of others behind their backs.
examples.zh: 在背后说别人坏话不是大丈夫所为。

mar.translation: vt. 损毁, 损伤, 糟蹋\nn. 三月

examples.en: It is said that there is no life on Mars.
examples.zh: 据说火星上是没有生物的。

examples.en: In the zoos on Mars, there are animals from Earth.
examples.zh: 火星的动物园里有来自地球的动物。

examples.en: The temples on Mars are decorated with lotus flowers.
examples.zh: 火星上的神殿饰有莲花。

martyr.definition:
n. one who suffers for the sake of principle
n. one who voluntarily suffers death as the penalty for refusing to renounce their religion
v. kill as a martyr
v. torture and torment like a martyr
martyr.translation: n. 烈士, 受苦者, 受难者\nvt. 使成为烈士, 使受苦

examples.en: A holy martyr was depicted on the icon.
Peter and Paul said that they would also die as martyrs.
The martyrs throughout history always faced opposition for their personal beliefs.

martyrdom.definition: n. death that is imposed because of the person's adherence of a religious faith or cause
martyrdom.translation: n. 殉教, 殉难, 殉节

examples.en: What do you think are the problems that underlie your obsession with martyrdom?
Tom is obsessed with martyrdom.
Miroslav knows exactly the kind of martyrdom Rima suffered at the hands of the legionnaires.

massage.definition: n. kneading and rubbing parts of the body to increase circulation and promote relaxation\nv. manually manipulate (someone's body), usually for medicinal or relaxation purposes\nv. give a massage to
massage.translation: n. 按摩, 揉\nvt. 按摩, 揉

examples.en: I want a massage. I need to relax.
examples.zh: 我想要按摩。我需要放松。

examples.en: She works as a massage therapist.
examples.zh: 她是按摩师。

examples.en: She gave him a massage.
examples.zh: 她给他做了个按摩。

mastery.definition: n. the act of mastering or subordinating someone
mastery.translation: n. 征服, 统治权, 优势, 精通, 掌握\n[法] 统治权, 控制权, 征服

examples.en: The road to mastery is oh so long.
examples.zh: 学习之路如此漫长。

maternal.definition: a. characteristic of a mother\na. relating to or derived from one's mother
maternal.translation: a. 母亲的, 母系的, 母方的\n[医] 属母的, 母的, 母性的

examples.en: Maternal love is greater than anything else.
examples.zh: 母爱比任何别的东西都伟大。

examples.en: My mother's father is my maternal grandfather.
examples.zh: 我妈妈的爸爸是我的外公。

maximal.definition: a. the greatest or most complete or best possible
maximal.translation: a. 最大的, 最高的\n[医] 最大的, 最高的

meaty.definition: a. like or containing meat; let's have a meaty meal"\ns. being on topic and prompting thought
meaty.translation: a. 肉的, 似肉的, 多肉的

examples.en: Tom is holding a giant meaty bone.

mechanics.definition: n. the branch of physics concerned with the motion of bodies in a frame of reference
mechanics.translation: n. 机械学, 结构, 力学\n[化] 力学

examples.en: I thought you said Tom and Mary were mechanics.
Could you find me a couple of competent mechanics?
This guy says that he can fix what five mechanics can't.

medicare.definition: n. health care for the aged; a federally administered system of health insurance available to persons aged 65 and over
medicare.translation: n. 医疗照顾方案, 医疗照顾项目\n[法] 公办的医疗保险制

examples.en: Nearly 50 million older Americans and Americans with disabilities rely on Medicare each year.
Many doctors don't accept Medicare.
We finally beat Medicare!

memorandum.definition: n a written proposal or reminder
memorandum.translation: n. 备忘录, 外交备忘录, 交易备忘录\n[经] 备忘录, 便笺, 便函

examples.en: I haven't yet read the new memorandum on internal security.
In Tom's briefcase I've found a memorandum of a conversation.
This memorandum shall be published in the Federal Register.

meritorious.translation: a. 有功绩的, 有价值的, 可称赞的\n[法] 有功的, 值得称赞的, 善意的

examples.en: Laszlo received a medal for meritorious service.
To do good to others is a meritorious act; to hurt others is a sin.

metric.definition: a. based on the meter as a standard of measurement
metric.translation: a. 公尺的, 公制的, 计量的\n[医] 测量的, 米制的, 公制的

examples.en: This chocolate factory consumes twenty metric tons of raw cocoa per day.
examples.zh: 这座巧克力工厂每一天消耗二十公吨可可原料。

examples.en: To change the units from metric to imperial and vice versa, the 'menu' button must be clicked.
examples.zh: 要把公制单位换算成英制或反过来操作，须点击“菜单”按钮。

metro.definition: n. an electric railway operating below the surface of the ground (usually in a city)

examples.en: Almost stepped on a gecko while going to the metro.
examples.zh: 去地铁的路上差点踩到一只壁虎。

examples.en: I thought that the metro was free, so I went without a ticket.
examples.zh: 我以为地铁是免费的，所以我没买票就去了。

examples.en: There is a metro in Kazan.
examples.zh: 喀山有地铁。

microscopic.definition:
a. of or relating to or used in microscopy
s. visible under a microscope; using a microscope
s. extremely precise with great attention to details
s. so small as to be invisible without a microscope
microscopic.translation: a. 显微镜的, 用显微镜可见的, 微观的, (非正式)极微小的, 细微的\n[计] 微观的

examples.en: This new state could in principle be any microscopic state.
Microplastics are microscopic particles of plastic debris that pollute the oceans.
Dan performed a microscopic examination of the hair.

microwavable.translation: a. 适合于微波炉烧煮的

examples.en: Is this container microwavable?

middle.definition:
n. an intermediate part or section
n. the middle area of the human torso (usually in front)
n. time between the beginning and the end of a temporal period
v. put in the middle
middle.translation: n. 中央, 中间, 腰部\na. 中央的, 中庸的, 中间的

examples.en: There is a park in the middle of the city.
examples.zh: 城市中央有一座公园。

examples.en: Kansas is smack dab in the middle of the US.
examples.zh: 堪萨斯州刚好位于美国的中央。

examples.en: A truck was standing in the middle of the road.
examples.zh: 路中间有一辆卡车。

migrant.definition: n. traveler who moves from one region or country to another\ns. habitually moving from place to place especially in search of seasonal work
migrant.translation: n. 候鸟, 移居者\n[法] 移居者

examples.en: The migrant hoped to also get a mouthful of food.
Ziri was being held in prison for helping a migrant.
Sami will always remain just a migrant for my father.

milestone.definition: n. stone post at side of a road to show distances\nn. a significant event in your life (or in a project)
milestone.translation: n. 里程碑, 里程石, 里程标

examples.en: Carlos's exam was a major milestone in his academic career.
That day was an important milestone in our project.
She sees the service award as a milestone in her career.
Collateral damage caused by the strikes is fueling militancy in the region.

mindset.definition: n a habitual or characteristic mental attitude that determines how you will interpret and respond to situations
mindset.translation: n. 心态；倾向；习惯；精神状态

examples.en: He must learn to approach things with a serious mindset.
I think believing that is a matter of mindset.
You need a positive mindset to overcome these obstacles.

miraculous.definition: s being or having the character of a miracle\ns peculiarly fortunate or appropriate; as if by divine intervention
miraculous.translation: a. 奇迹的, 不可思议的

examples.en: The healer always has some miraculous products to sell.
This medicine is known for its miraculous healing powers.
This healer seems to always have some miraculous products to sell.

misfortune.definition: n. unnecessary and unforeseen trouble resulting from an unfortunate event\nn. an unfortunate state resulting from unfavorable outcomes
misfortune.translation: n. 不幸, 灾祸, 坏运气\n[法] 不幸事故, 不幸, 灾祸

examples.en: What greater misfortune is there than to go blind?
examples.zh: 有什么比失明更不幸的呢？

examples.en: I bear in mind that misfortunes never come singly.
examples.zh: 我谨记祸不单行。

examples.en: A misfortune befell him.
examples.zh: 不幸降临到他的头上。

modesty.definition: n. freedom from vanity or conceit\nn. formality and propriety of manner
modesty.translation: n. 谦逊, 质朴, 羞怯

examples.en: Even when one is being praised, modesty is important.
examples.zh: 即使在受到表扬的时候，谦虚也是很重要的。

examples.en: His modesty is worth respecting.
examples.zh: 他的谦逊值得尊敬。

modifier.definition: n. a content word that qualifies the meaning of a noun or verb\nn. a moderator who makes less extreme or uncompromising\nn. a gene that modifies the effect produced by another gene
modifier.translation: n. 修正的人, 修饰语\n[计] 修改量

examples.en: A "modifier" has, just as it sounds, the role of embellishing sentences.
There are grammar books that call these sorts of things, not modifiers, but adjuncts (A).

moldy.definition: s. covered with or smelling of mold
moldy.translation: a. 发霉的, 腐臭的

examples.en: A moldy loaf of bread lay on the table.
examples.zh: 台子上有个发霉的面包。

momentarily.definition: r. for an instant or moment\nr. at any moment
momentarily.translation: adv. 暂时地, 立刻, 随时地

examples.en: A flash of lightning momentarily lit up the backyard.
Lorenzo momentarily left the party to check his apartment.
We will be landing at Tokyo International Airport momentarily.

momentary.definition: s lasting for a markedly brief time
momentary.translation: a. 瞬间的, 刹那间的

examples.en: Victory attained by violence is tantamount to a defeat, for it is momentary.
examples.zh: 靠武力取胜，犹如落败，因为这样的胜利不会长久。

monarchy.definition: n. an autocracy governed by a monarch who usually inherits the authority
monarchy.translation: n. 君主政体, 君主国, 君主政治\n[法] 君主政体, 君主制度, 君主国

examples.en: The Vatican is an absolute monarchy with an elected king.
In Morocco, insulting the monarchy can land you in prison.
The protests of 2011 threatened to topple the entire Moroccan monarchy.

monotony.definition: n. the quality of wearisome constancy, routine, and lack of variety\nn. constancy of tone or pitch or inflection
monotony.translation: n. 单调, 缺乏变化

examples.en: I was bored with the monotony of daily life.
Monotony develops when you harp on the same string.
I’m done with the monotony of life.

monstrous.translation: a. 巨大的, 畸形的, 怪异的\n[法] 巨大的, 异形的, 畸形的:荒诞的

examples.en: Lukas shot Rima as she transformed into something more monstrous.
The tip led the police to a monstrous crime.
We're all going to be eaten by a monstrous talking shrubbery.

mortal.definition: a. subject to death\ns. unrelenting and deadly
mortal.translation: n. 生物, 人类\na. 不免一死的, 人类的, 临终的

examples.en: We know that all men are mortal.
examples.zh: 我们知道人皆难免一死。

examples.en: Mortal enemies are immortal friends.
examples.zh: 不共戴天的敌人是不朽的朋友。

examples.en: The flesh is mortal.
examples.zh: 肉体终有一死。

mortality.definition: n. the quality or state of being mortal
mortality.translation: n. 必死的命运, 死亡数目, 死亡率\n[医] 必死性, 死亡率

examples.en: Teen pregnancy carries a high risk of maternal mortality.
People do not enjoy being confronted with their mortality.
I'm very self-conscious about my own mortality as a human being.

motherly.definition: s. befitting a mother; warm and nurturing

examples.en: Sami was trying to be motherly to Sami's kids.
Layla was trying to be motherly to Sami's children.
Stefan stirred up motherly feelings within Anna.

multilateral.definition: a. having many parts or sides
multilateral.translation: a. 多边的, 多国的\n[经] 多边的, 涉及多方的

examples.en: Multilateral trade negotiations ran aground over import quotas.

multiplication.definition: n. a multiplicative increase\nn. an arithmetic operation that is the inverse of division; the product of two numbers is computed
multiplication.translation: n. 乘法, 增加, 乘法运算\n[医] 增殖; 倍增

examples.en: Do you know the difference between addition, subtraction, and multiplication?
The children are learning the multiplication tables by heart.
Many students find quaternion arithmetic unintuitive because it has non-commutative multiplication.

multitude.definition: n. a large gathering of people\nn. the common people generally

examples.en: It is a great joy to see your own sentences translated into a multitude of other languages.
examples.zh: 看到你自己的句子被翻译成多种语言是一件很开心的事情。

muscular.definition: a. of or relating to or consisting of muscle\ns. having or suggesting great physical power or force
muscular.translation: a. 强壮的, 肌肉发达的, 有力的\n[医] 肌的; 肌肉发达的

examples.en: Muscular dystrophy is an incredibly rare, but extremely serious disease.
Boris was tall and muscular with a gray beard.
With his muscular constitution he passes for a judoist.

mutter.definition: n. a low continuous indistinct sound; often accompanied by movement of the lips without the production of articulate speech
mutter.translation: n. 喃喃低语\nvi. 喃喃自语, 作低沉声\nvt. 出怨言, 抱怨地说

examples.en: I heard Tom muttering something in French.
examples.zh: 我听到汤姆在用法语嘀咕些什么。

examples.en: He muttered something under his breath.
examples.zh: 他压低声线，喃喃自语地说了些话。

mariner.definition: n. a man who serves as a sailor

examples.en: In 1974, Mariner 10 took almost 3000 pictures of the surface of Mercury.
The first spacecraft from Earth to visit Mars was Mariner 4 in 1965.
Mariner 9 was launched on May 30, 1971.

mayfly.definition: n. slender insect with delicate membranous wings having an aquatic larval stage and terrestrial adult stage usually lasting less than two days
mayfly.translation: n. 蜉蝣, 蜉蝣状钓饵

examples.en: "We shouldn't have to wait too much time with the honeymoon, darling", said the mayfly.
You can learn a lot about what can be done in 24 hours by observing the mayfly.
Mayflies are ephemeral. As adults they live but a day. Sometimes it's a rainy day.

mediocre.definition: s. moderate to inferior in quality\ns. poor to middling in quality
mediocre.translation: a. 不好不坏的, 通常, 平凡的

examples.en: Elias had a mediocre academic record with C's and D's.
You can have mediocre results now, or outstanding results later.
"Who's Salman Rushdie to you?" "I'd say he's a mediocre writer."

middle-class.definition: a occupying a socioeconomic position intermediate between those of the lower classes and the wealthy
middle-class.translation: a. 中层社会的, 中产阶级的

examples.en: Fentanyl pills are more palatable to middle-class Americans than heroin.
Tom Jackson is a caricature of a middle-class reactionary.
The majority of these emigrants are well-educated and middle-class.

minus.definition: a. on the negative side or lower end of a scale\ns. involving disadvantage or harm
minus.translation:
n. 负号, 不足
a. 减的, 负的, 阴性的
prep. 减, 缺
[计] 负差

examples.en: How many is nine minus six?
examples.zh: 九减六等于多少？

examples.en: Seven minus two is five.
examples.zh: 七减二是五。

examples.en: Eight minus four is four.
examples.zh: 八减四得四。

motorway.definition: n a broad highway designed for high-speed traffic

examples.en: The toilets at motorway service stations are often very dirty.
examples.zh: 服务站的卫生间大多很脏。

examples.en: The accident happened on the motorway.
examples.zh: 事故发生在高速公路上。

moving.definition: a. in motion\na. arousing or capable of arousing deep emotion\na. used of a series of photographs presented so as to create the illusion of motion
moving.translation: a. 动人的, 令人感动的, 鼓动的, 原动的, [无比较级]活动的, 转动的

examples.en: The man is loading the moving truck on his own.
examples.zh: 这个男人独自把东西搬上搬家卡车上。

examples.en: Tom told Mary that he was moving to Boston.
examples.zh: 汤姆对玛丽说了他将搬到波士顿。

examples.en: It is dangerous to jump onto a moving train.
examples.zh: 跳上一列正在开的火车是很危险的。

mow.definition: v. cut with a blade or mower
mow.translation: n. 草堆, 皱眉, 怪脸\nvt. 割草\nvi. 割草, 做怪脸

examples.en: I didn't charge Tom anything to mow his lawn.
examples.zh: 我修剪汤姆的草坪，没有向他收取任何费用。

examples.en: I'm going to mow the lawn tomorrow, weather permitting.
examples.zh: 如果天气情况允许的话，我明天就去割草坪。

examples.en: Mother told me to mow the lawn.
examples.zh: 妈妈叫我修剪草坪。

mud.definition: n. water soaked soil; soft wet earth\nn. slanderous remarks or charges\nv. plaster with mud
mud.translation: n. 泥, 诽谤\nvt. 弄脏

examples.en: People who play with mud will get their hands dirty.
examples.zh: 玩泥的人会弄脏自己的双手。

examples.en: He was covered in mud from head to foot.
examples.zh: 他从头到脚都是泥巴。

examples.en: He was covered with mud from head to foot.
examples.zh: 他从头到脚都是泥巴。

mug.definition: n. the quantity that can be held in a mug\nn. with handle and usually cylindrical\nv. rob at gunpoint or with the threat of violence
mug.translation: n. 有柄大杯, 脸, 苦读者\nvt. 给...拍照, 攻击, 苦读\nvi. 拼命用功

examples.en: The beer mug is almost bigger than you are.
examples.zh: 啤酒杯差一点比你还大。

examples.en: The spatulas, ramekins, plates, and mugs are all from the collection.
examples.zh: 这些锅铲、烤盅、盘子和马克杯都来自这套集合。

municipality.definition: n. an urban district having corporate status and powers of self-government\nn. people living in a town or city having local self-government
municipality.translation: n. 自治区, 市当局, 市民\n[法] 市, 自治市, 自治地区

examples.en: Viana is a Brazilian municipality with an estimate population of 65000.
Nilópolis is the smallest municipality in Rio de Janeiro State.
The municipality has recently imposed an overtaking ban for this road.

mutate.translation: vi. 变化, 产生变异, 变化元音\nvt. 使变异

examples.en: The virus is starting to mutate.
examples.zh: 病毒开始变异了。

madam.definition: n. a woman who runs a house of prostitution

examples.en: My name is Mary but you can call me madam.
I know where you live, Madam. But that is confidential.
Hello, madam, did your husband perhaps call me last night?

magician.definition: n. someone who performs magic tricks to amuse an audience
magician.translation: n. 魔术家, 幻术家, 术士

examples.en: I have a friend whose father is a magician.
examples.zh: 我有一个父亲是魔术师的朋友。

examples.en: Sami is not good at being a magician.
examples.zh: 萨米不是个好的魔术师。

examples.en: I want to be a magician.
examples.zh: 我想成为一个魔法师。

magnetism.definition: n. attraction for iron; associated with electric currents as well as magnets; characterized by fields of force\nn. the branch of science that studies magnetism
magnetism.translation: n. 磁性, 吸引力, 磁学, 催眠术\n[化] 磁学

examples.en: An electric current can generate magnetism.
examples.zh: 电流可以产生磁性。

examples.en: The discovery that electric currents can be produced by magnetism is extremely important in the field of electricity.
examples.zh: 磁能生产电流的发明，在电力领域非常重要。

maid.definition: n. a female domestic\nn. an unmarried girl (especially a virgin)
maid.translation: n. 少女, 未婚女子, 女仆

examples.en: Mary is a good maid.
examples.zh: 玛丽是个好女佣。

examples.en: My maid is amazing.
examples.zh: 我的丫鬟可厉害了。

managerial.definition: a. of or relating to the function or responsibility or activity of management
managerial.translation: a. 管理的\n[经] 管理上的, 经营上的

examples.en: My classmate, Xiao Ming, has strong managerial capability.
examples.zh: 小明同学管理能力很强。

manoeuvre.definition:
n a plan for attaining a particular goal
n a military training exercise
n a deliberate coordinated movement requiring dexterity and skill
n a move made to gain a tactical end
n an action aimed at evading an opponent
v act in order to achieve a certain goal
v direct the course; determine the direction of travelling
v perform a movement in military or naval tactics in order to secure an advantage in attack or defense
manoeuvre.translation: n. 调遣, 演习, 策略\nvi. 调动, 演习, 用策略\nvt. 调动, 操纵

examples.en: Do you know the Heimlich manoeuvre?
examples.zh: 你知道海姆利克急救法吗？

married.definition: n. a person who is married\na. joined in matrimony
married.translation: a. 已婚的, 婚姻的\n[法] 结了婚的, 有配偶的, 夫妇的

examples.en: I made up my mind to get married to Margaret.
examples.zh: 我决定要和 Margaret 结婚。

examples.en: I hear she is going to get married next month.
examples.zh: 我听说，她下个月结婚了。

examples.en: If she had married you, she would be happy now.
examples.zh: 如果她和你结婚了，她现在会很幸福。

marry.definition: v. take in marriage\nv. perform a marriage ceremony
marry.translation: vt. 与...结婚, 娶, 嫁\nvi. 结婚

examples.en: Why would you marry a woman if you like men?
examples.zh: 喜欢男人，为什么还要和女人结婚？

examples.en: I hope that your parents will allow us to marry.
examples.zh: 希望你父母会让我们结婚吧。

examples.en: Her life goal is to marry a rich man.
examples.zh: 她的人生目标就是找个有钱的老公。

marshal.definition:
n. a law officer having duties similar to those of a sheriff in carrying out the judgments of a court of law
n. (in some countries) a military officer of highest rank
v. place in proper rank
v. arrange in logical order
marshal.translation: n. 元帅, 陆空军高级将官, 典礼官, 执法官\nvt. 整理, 引领, 统率\nvi. 排列, 各就各位

examples.en: US Marshal Tom Jackson is determined to recover the fugitive.
You don't need a college degree to be a sky marshal.
Tom Jackson, a US Marshal, escorted prisoners to a state penitentiary.

marvellous.definition: s extraordinarily good or great; used especially as intensifiers\ns being or having the character of a miracle\ns too improbable to admit of belief
marvellous.translation: a. 奇异的, 神奇的, 奇迹般的, 惊人的, 不可思议的, 绝妙的, 妙极的

examples.en: I don't know what it was, but it was marvellous!
He found a marvellous place for Mary to stay.
This museum has a marvellous collection of modern art.

masculinity.definition: n. the trait of behaving in ways considered typical for men
masculinity.translation: n. 男子气, 刚毅, 大丈夫气概\n[医] 男子本性, 男性

examples.en: This film attempts to break stereotypes and redefine what true masculinity is.
examples.zh: 这部电影试图打破刻板印象，重新诠释何谓真正的男性特质。

mast.definition:
n. a vertical spar for supporting sails
n. nuts of forest trees (as beechnuts and acorns) accumulated on the ground
n. nuts of forest trees used as feed for swine
n. any sturdy upright pole
mast.translation: n. 桅, 桅杆, 杆\nvt. 装桅杆于

examples.en: Ulysses asked his men to tie him to the mast.
The main mast of the USS Constellation is 220 feet tall.
The sailor climbed the ratlines to reach the mast.

materialism.definition: n. a desire for wealth and material possessions with little interest in ethical or spiritual matters\nn. (philosophy) the philosophical theory that matter is the only reality

examples.en: The difference between materialism and idealism is that materialism works.
The pillars of the new world are materialism, egoism and idiocy.
Life is best lived unencumbered by materialism.

maths.definition: n a science (or group of related sciences) dealing with the logic of quantity and shape and arrangement\nn a science (or group of related sciences) dealing with the logic of quantity and shape and arrangement

examples.en: In IT companies, people who are good at maths are well respected.
examples.zh: 在 IT 公司里，数学好的人容易得到尊敬。

examples.en: He asked me if I like maths.
examples.zh: 他问我喜不喜欢数学。

examples.en: Chinese children are especially good at maths.
examples.zh: 中国小孩特别擅长数学。

maturation.definition: n. coming to full development; becoming mature
maturation.translation: n. 化脓, 成熟\n[医] 成熟, 化脓

means.definition: n. how a result is obtained or an end is achieved\nn. an instrumentality for accomplishing some end\nn. considerable capital (wealth or income)
means.translation: n. 方法, 手段, 工具, 财产, 收入\n[经] 方法, 手段, 工具; 意谓

examples.en: At any rate, we have no means of helping him.
examples.zh: 无论如何，我们也帮不了他。

examples.en: Frank left a message by means of a secret code.
examples.zh: 法兰克用暗号留下了一则讯息。

examples.en: The doctor tried every possible means to save his patient.
examples.zh: 为抢救病人医生已尽力了。

measurable.definition: a. capable of being measured\ns. of distinguished importance
measurable.translation: a. 可测量的, 不久的, 重要的

examples.en: The results should be measurable and the process repeatable.
To set attainable, measurable goals is very important to successful language learning.
The scientific method accounts for measurable uncertainties.

measurement.definition: n. the act or process of assigning numbers to phenomena according to a rule
measurement.translation: n. 尺寸, 度量, 度量单位\n[计] 度量, 度量单位

examples.en: That can't be. It must be an error in measurement.
In the imperial measurement system, four quarts equals one gallon.
The science of mensuration is vital for accurate measurement techniques.

mechanically.definition: r. in a mechanical manner; by a mechanism\nr. in a machinelike manner; without feeling
mechanically.translation: adv. 机械, 用机械, 机械学, 物理, 力学, 呆板, 无意识, 手工操作, 技工

examples.en: Ziri mechanically waved at the cops.
Here the potatoes are harvested mechanically.
He did it mechanically.

merciful.definition: a. showing or giving mercy\ns. (used conventionally of royalty and high nobility) gracious
merciful.translation: a. 仁慈的, 慈悲的

examples.en: Blessed are the merciful: for they will be shown mercy.
Blessed are the merciful, for they themselves shall obtain mercy.
In the name of God, the Gracious, the Merciful.

mesh.definition: n. the number of openings per linear inch of a screen; measures size of particles\nn. the act of interlocking or meshing\nv. work together in harmony
mesh.translation: n. 网孔, 网丝, 网眼, 网状物, 圈套, 陷阱, 啮合\nvt. 以网捕捉, 啮合, 使缠住\nvi. 落网, 相啮合

examples.en: Ziri asked Rima if he could borrow her mesh skimmer.
Their comedic styles mesh well with each others'.
Sami and Layla were working on meshing their families.

metallurgy.definition: n. the science and technology of metals
metallurgy.translation: n. 冶金学, 冶金术\n[化] 冶金

examples.en: Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania is a historically important city for metallurgy.
Tom is a metallurgy professor at Harvard University.
Is Boston a major center for metallurgy?

metre.definition: n the basic unit of length adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites (approximately 1.094 yards)\nn (prosody) the accent in a metrical foot of verse\nn rhythm as given by division into parts of equal duration
metre.translation: n. 公尺, 格律, 韵律\n[医] 米, 公尺

examples.en: String is sold by the metre.
examples.zh: 绳子按米卖。

examples.en: That is 30 metres long.
examples.zh: 那个长30米。

microcomputer.definition: n a small digital computer based on a microprocessor and designed to be used by one person at a time
microcomputer.translation: n. 微电脑, 微机\n[计] 微型计算机; 微计算机

examples.en: The invention of the microcomputer revolutionized personal and business computing.
The engineer designed a custom microcomputer to control the laboratory equipment.
Students learned BASIC programming on a simple microcomputer connected to a small monitor.

microprocessor.definition: n. integrated circuit semiconductor chip that performs the bulk of the processing and controls the parts of a system
microprocessor.translation: n. 微处理器\n[计] 微处理器; 微处理机

examples.en: This computer has a Pentium microprocessor.
Modern microprocessors typically contain billions of transistors.

microwave.definition: n. a short electromagnetic wave (longer than infrared but shorter than radio waves); used for radar and microwave ovens and for transmitting telephone, facsimile, video and data\nn. kitchen appliance that cooks food by passing an electromagnetic wave through it; heat results from the absorption of energy by the water molecules in the food\nv. cook or heat in a microwave oven

examples.en: It is about time we bought a new microwave oven.
examples.zh: 我们是时候买新的微波炉了。

examples.en: The cause of this fire was a microwave oven.
examples.zh: 这场火灾的起因是一个微波炉。

examples.en: That year's buzzword was digital: digital clocks, digital microwave ovens, even digital pens.
examples.zh: 那一年的流行语是「数位」：数位钟、数位微波炉，甚至还有数位笔。

midday.definition: n the middle of the day
midday.translation: n. 正午, 中午\na. 正午的

examples.en: Will you be at home at midday today?
examples.zh: 今天中午你在家吗？

examples.en: They will contact us before midday today.
examples.zh: 他们会在今天中午之前联系我们。

midnight.definition: n. 12 o'clock at night; the middle of the night
midnight.translation: n. 午夜, 子夜, 半夜\na. 午夜的, 半夜的

examples.en: Heads up! The server will shut down at midnight.
examples.zh: 注意了！服务器半夜要停机。

examples.en: It was almost midnight when we got home.
examples.zh: 我们到家时几乎是半夜了。

examples.en: I had instant noodles as a midnight snack.
examples.zh: 我消夜吃了速食面。

might.translation: n. 力量, 权力\naux. 可能, 也许

examples.en: I think that Tom might not want to do that.
examples.zh: 我认为汤姆可能不想那样做。

examples.en: I might give up soon and have a kip instead.
examples.zh: 也许我会马上放弃然后去打盹。

examples.en: Anger me again, I might just peel your skin off.
examples.zh: 再惹我生气，小心我扒了你的皮！

mile.definition:
n. a unit of length equal to 1,760 yards or 5,280 feet; exactly 1609.344 meters
n. a large distance
n. an ancient Roman unit of length equivalent to 1620 yards
n. a Swedish unit of length equivalent to 10 km
mile.translation: n. 英里, 很大距离\n[机] 英里, 哩

examples.en: My house is only a mile from here.
examples.zh: 我的家离这里只有一英里。

examples.en: The post office is half a mile away.
examples.zh: 邮局离这儿有半英里。

examples.en: In China, talented people are often described as "ten thousand mile horses".
examples.zh: 在中国，人们常把有能力的人喻为“千里马”。

milky.definition: s. resembling milk in color not clear
milky.translation: a. 乳状的, 乳白色的, 柔和的

examples.en: The solar system is a small celestial system in the Milky Way.
examples.zh: 太阳系是银河系中一个小的天体系统。

millimetre.definition: n a metric unit of length equal to one thousandth of a meter

examples.en: A millimetre is a thousandth of a metre.
We've insulated the house with expanded polystyrene foam panels, 100 millimetres thick.
The annual rainfall amounts to just 400 millimetres.

miner.definition: n. laborer who works in a mine
miner.translation: n. 矿工, 开矿机, 坑道工兵\n[经] 矿工

examples.en: I know that Tom used to be a coal miner.
I thought you knew that Tom was a coal miner.
I thought that you knew Tom was a coal miner.

mint.definition:
n. any north temperate plant of the genus Mentha with aromatic leaves and small mauve flowers
n. any member of the mint family of plants
n. the leaves of a mint plant used fresh or candied
n. a candy that is flavored with a mint oil
mint.translation: n. 薄荷, 造币厂, 巨额\nvt. 铸造, 铸币, 制造

examples.en: Put a sprig of mint on top as a garnish.
This green color always reminds me of mint ice cream.
I love ice cream with a taste of mint.

miser.definition: n. a stingy hoarder of money and possessions (often living miserably)
miser.translation: n. 守财奴, 吝啬鬼, (石油工程上用的)锥钻头

examples.en: The miser opened the box to find his money stolen.
examples.zh: 这个守财奴打开了盒子，发现他的钱被偷了。

examples.en: A miser hoards money not because he is prudent but because he is greedy.
examples.zh: 守财奴积聚钱财不是因为他谨慎，而是因为他贪婪。

examples.en: What a miser you are!
examples.zh: 你真是个吝啬鬼！

missing.definition: s. not able to be found
missing.translation: a. 不见的, 缺少的\n[法] 行踪不明的, 失踪的, 遗失的

examples.en: We listened with great care, not missing a single word.
examples.zh: 我们一字不落的，专心致志的听着。

examples.en: As far as I know, she is still missing.
examples.zh: 据我所知，她仍然失踪。

examples.en: Check the tools and see if anything is missing.
examples.zh: 检点一下工具，看有无丢失。

mist.definition: n. a thin fog with condensation near the ground\nv. become covered with mist\nv. spray finely or cover with mist
mist.translation: n. 雾, 迷蒙, 朦胧不清\nvt. 使模糊, 使蒙上雾\nvi. 变模糊, 下雾

examples.en: A boat suddenly appeared out of the mist.
examples.zh: 一艘船突然从雾中出现。

examples.en: In looking through the mist, I caught a glimpse of my future.
examples.zh: 透过薄雾，我隐约看见了我的未来。

examples.en: Mist hung over the fields and footpaths.
examples.zh: 田野和小径被雾气笼罩著。

mistress.definition: n. an adulterous woman; a woman who has an ongoing extramarital sexual relationship with a man\nn. a woman master who directs the work of others
mistress.translation: n. 主妇, 女主人, 情妇

examples.en: I'd rather be dead than be the mistress of anyone.
There was a provision in his will for his mistress.
From that tone, I suppose he's with his mistress now.

mitten.definition: n. glove that encases the thumb separately and the other four fingers together
mitten.translation: n. 连指手套, 拳击手套

examples.en: Vanessa loves to knit hats, scarves, and mittens in rainbow colors.
examples.zh: Vanessa喜欢针织彩虹色的帽子、围巾和连指手套。

mixer.definition: n. club soda or fruit juice used to mix with alcohol\nn. electronic equipment that mixes two or more input signals to give a single output signal\nn. a kitchen utensil that is used for mixing foods
mixer.translation: n. 混合者, 混合器, 搅拌机, 搅拌器, 混频器, (非正式)交际家, 与人相处的人\n[计] 混频器, 音装置

examples.en: When I used the mixer, I got myself all messy.
Remove the beaters from the mixer before you lick them.
Yanni hasn't had time to fix the basin mixer.

moderately.definition: r. with moderation; in a moderate manner
moderately.translation: adv. 适当地, 适度地, 中庸地

examples.en: This is moderately spicy, but it does stimulate the appetite.
This is moderately spicy, but it does get your juices flowing.
Here is a list of moderately priced restaurants.

modulate.definition: v. change the key of, in music\nv. adjust the pitch, tone, or volume of\nv. vary the frequency, amplitude, phase, or other characteristic of (electromagnetic waves)
modulate.translation: vt. 调整, 使转调, 控制\nvi. 转调, 调制

examples.en: In this section, the composer modulates to many different keys.
In this section, the piece modulates to the parallel minor key.
We've seen law enforcement across the country start to take a more modulated approach.

monk.definition: n. a male religious living in a cloister and devoting himself to contemplation and prayer and work\nn. United States jazz pianist who was one of the founders of the bebop style (1917-1982)
monk.translation: n. 修道士, 僧侣, 和尚

examples.en: Tom has decided to become a monk.
examples.zh: 汤姆(Tom)决定出家为僧。

examples.en: Tom decided to become a monk.
examples.zh: 汤姆(Tom)决定出家为僧。

monthly.definition: n. a periodical that is published every month (or 12 issues per year)\ns. of or occurring or payable every month\nr. occurring once a month
monthly.translation: n. 月刊\na. 每月的, 每月一次的

examples.en: How much is the monthly fee of this swimming school?
examples.zh: 这间游泳学校每个月的学费是多少？

examples.en: Her husband intends to bring out a new monthly magazine.
examples.zh: 他丈夫打算办月刊。

examples.en: How much is your monthly gas bill?
examples.zh: 你每个月的瓦斯费多少钱？

moor.definition:
n. one of the Muslim people of north Africa; of mixed Arab and Berber descent; converted to Islam in the 8th century; conqueror of Spain in the 8th century
n. open land usually with peaty soil covered with heather and bracken and moss
v. secure in or as if in a berth or dock
v. come into or dock at a wharf
moor.translation: n.荒野；旷野\nMoor: 摩尔人.\nv.系住；停泊

examples.en: The Moor has done his duty, the Moor can go.
Go back, and never set foot upon the moor again.
A long, low moan, indescribably sad, swept over the moor.

mop.definition: n cleaning implement consisting of absorbent material fastened to a handle; for cleaning floors\nv to wash or wipe with or as if with a mop\nv make a sad face and thrust out one's lower lip
mop.translation:
n. 拖把, 鬼脸
vt. 用拖把洗擦, 擦, 拭
vi. 做鬼脸
[计] 维护操作协议

examples.en: When you're done sweeping, I'll mop.
examples.zh: 你扫完以后，我会拖地。

examples.en: When you've finished sweeping, I'll mop.
examples.zh: 你扫完以后，我会拖地。

examples.en: Tom mopped the floor.
examples.zh: 汤姆擦了地板。

moss.translation: n. 苔藓, 泥沼\nvt. 使长满苔藓

examples.en: "A rolling stone gathers no moss" is a saying.
examples.zh: “滚石不生苔”是一句谚语。

examples.en: "A rolling stone gathers no moss" is a proverb.
examples.zh: “滚石不生苔”是一句谚语。

examples.en: A rolling stone gathers no moss.
examples.zh: 滚石不生苔。

mostly.definition: r in large part; mainly or chiefly\nr usually; as a rule
mostly.translation: adv. 大概, 大部分, 主要\n[经] 大部份

examples.en: I mostly have fruit for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早饭主要吃水果。

examples.en: Tom mostly kept to himself.
examples.zh: 汤姆大多一个人独处。

mould.definition:
n loose soil rich in organic matter
n the distinctive form in which a thing is made
n the process of becoming mildewed
n a fungus that produces a superficial growth on various kinds of damp or decaying organic matter
n a dish or dessert that is formed in or on a mold
n a distinctive nature, character, or type
n sculpture produced by molding
n container into which liquid is poured to create a given shape when it hardens
v form in clay, wax, etc
v form by pouring (e.g., wax or hot metal) into a cast or mold
v make something, usually for a specific function
mould.translation: n. 模子, 模制品, 松软沃土, 霉\nvt. 形成, 浇铸, 用泥土覆盖\nvi. 发霉

examples.en: The windows are draughty, and there's mould on the walls.
Mould began to form on the walls because of the damp.
There's mould in the corners of the room.

mountainous.definition: s. like a mountain in size and impressiveness\ns. containing many mountains
mountainous.translation: a. 多山的, 如山的, 巨大的

examples.en: Armenia is a mountainous country.
examples.zh: 亚美尼亚是一个多山的国家。

mouse.definition:
n. any of numerous small rodents typically resembling diminutive rats having pointed snouts and small ears on elongated bodies with slender usually hairless tails
n. person who is quiet or timid
n. a hand-operated electronic device that controls the coordinates of a cursor on your computer screen as you move it around on a pad; on the bottom of the device is a ball that rolls on the surface of the pad
v. manipulate the mouse of a computer
mouse.translation:
n. 老鼠, 胆小羞怯的人, 鼠标
vi. 捕鼠, 窥探
vt. 探出
[计] 鼠标

examples.en: The black cat is eating the white mouse.
examples.zh: 黑猫在吃白鼠

examples.en: The cat chased the mouse around the house.
examples.zh: 猫在房子里追老鼠。

examples.en: Walking along the fence he noticed a mouse.
examples.zh: 沿著栅栏走时, 他看到了一只老鼠。

mouthful.definition: n. the quantity that can be held in the mouth

examples.en: She gulped down half her tea in one mouthful.
examples.zh: 她一口气喝下半杯多凉茶。

movie.definition: n. a form of entertainment that enacts a story by sound and a sequence of images giving the illusion of continuous movement

examples.en: Do you want to be an actor in a movie?
examples.zh: 你想成为一名电影演员吗？

examples.en: Would you like to go see a movie with me?
examples.zh: 不如一起去看电影吧。

examples.en: I haven't had a chance to see the movie yet.
examples.zh: 我还没有机会看那部电影。

muddy.definition: v. dirty with mud\nv. cause to become muddy\nv. make turbid
muddy.translation: a. 泥泞的, 浑浊的, 模糊的\nvt. 使污浊, 使沾上泥污

examples.en: The passing car splashed muddy water on me.
examples.zh: 车子经过的时候把泥水溅到了我的身上。

examples.en: Because it had been raining for a couple of days, the pitch was muddy and difficult to play on.
examples.zh: 球队已经训练了几天，所以这个足球场有些泥泞，不太好用了。

murderer.definition: n. a criminal who commits homicide (who performs the unlawful premeditated killing of another human being)
murderer.translation: n. 凶手, 杀人者, 谋害者\n[法] 谋杀犯, 凶手

examples.en: The gardener turned out to be the murderer.
examples.zh: 园丁后来发现就是凶手。

examples.en: We were filled with anger against the murderer.
examples.zh: 我们对杀人犯感到悲愤填膺。

examples.en: This is proof that you're the murderer.
examples.zh: 这证明了你是杀人犯。

muse.definition: n. in ancient Greek mythology any of 9 daughters of Zeus and Mnemosyne; protector of an art or science\nn. the source of an artist's inspiration
muse.translation: n. 沉思, 冥想\nv. 沉思, 冥想, 若有所思地凝望或说

examples.en: "Novels? I hate novels." Oh muse, forgive her blasphemy.
examples.zh: 「小说啊？我就讨厌看小说。」天哪，请原谅她的亵渎行为。

musical.definition:
n. a play or film whose action and dialogue is interspersed with singing and dancing
a. characterized by or capable of producing music
a. talented in or devoted to music
a. characteristic of or resembling or accompanied by music
musical.translation: n. 音乐片, 音乐舞台剧\na. 音乐的, 声音美妙的, 喜爱音乐的

examples.en: Mozart: one of the great musical prodigies of all time.
examples.zh: 莫札特: 一个永远的音乐奇才

examples.en: To be honest, he doesn't have any musical talent.
examples.zh: 说实话，他没有任何音乐天分。

examples.en: Musical talent can be developed if it's properly trained.

musician.definition: n. someone who plays a musical instrument (as a profession)\nn. artist who composes or conducts music as a profession
musician.translation: n. 音乐家, 乐师, 作曲家

examples.en: Do you know when the musician will come here?
examples.zh: 你知道音乐家什么时候来这儿吗？

examples.en: He was destined to become a great musician.
examples.zh: 他命中注定要成为伟大的音乐家。

examples.en: In her opinion, he is the best musician she has ever seen.
examples.zh: 她认为他是她所见过最好的音乐家。

mutton.definition: n meat from a mature domestic sheep

examples.en: Dotur is a national Kalmyk dish made from mutton giblets.
Beef and mutton are often too expensive in Algeria.

mysterious.definition: s. having an import not apparent to the senses nor obvious to the intelligence; beyond ordinary understanding
mysterious.translation: a. 神秘的, 难解的, 不可思议的

examples.en: The scientists have not found any explanation for the mysterious phenomenon.
examples.zh: 科学家们尚未找到对这神秘现象的解释。

examples.en: This place has a mysterious atmosphere to it.
examples.zh: 这个地方的气氛很神秘。
